api-gateway.title: Payroll requests returned errors after a gateway deployment
api-gateway.description: Users opening payroll runs received intermittent 502 errors. Support reports and an increase in gateway error alerts revealed the problem.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incorrect upstream response parser. Rolling back the gateway release restored normal responses.

api-gateway.title: Time-off requests were routed to the wrong backend
api-gateway.description: Employees saw errors when submitting time-off requests through the API. Gateway route metrics showed traffic reaching an unrelated backend.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A configuration change mapped the time-off path to the wrong upstream. Restoring the correct route fixed the requests.

api-gateway.title: API clients could not establish secure connections
api-gateway.description: Payroll integrations failed to connect to the API gateway. Synthetic connection checks reported certificate validation failures.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway's TLS certificate had expired because its renewal configuration was incomplete. A replacement certificate was installed and automated renewal was corrected.

api-gateway.title: Employee profile requests failed during identity provider outage
api-gateway.description: Users could not access employee profiles because the gateway rejected requests that required token validation. Authentication failure alerts rose alongside reports from users.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The identity provider was unavailable and the gateway could not retrieve signing keys. Cached valid keys were restored and the provider recovered.

api-gateway.title: Gateway instances ran out of memory during bulk employee imports
api-gateway.description: Large employee import requests caused some gateway instances to restart. Users saw interrupted uploads and monitoring detected repeated memory exhaustion.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway buffered entire request bodies in memory instead of streaming them. Enabling streaming and adding a request size limit stopped the restarts.

api-gateway.title: API requests slowed while loading tenant routing rules
api-gateway.description: Requests across several tenant APIs took much longer than usual. Latency alerts pointed to delays before the gateway forwarded requests.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A routing-rule lookup used a slow database query after its index was removed. Restoring the index reduced lookup time.

api-gateway.title: Some tenants received invalid route configuration
api-gateway.description: Users in affected tenants received 404 errors for otherwise valid API endpoints. Tenant-specific error dashboards exposed the uneven failure pattern.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A corrupted gateway configuration record removed required route prefixes for those tenants. The records were repaired from a verified backup and the configuration cache was refreshed.

api-gateway.title: Gateway could not resolve the payroll backend
api-gateway.description: Payroll API calls failed with 502 errors while other API calls continued to work. Gateway logs showed repeated name resolution failures for the payroll backend.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the backend's service record. Restoring the record and clearing stale resolver entries restored routing.

api-gateway.title: Gateway lost permission to read signing keys
api-gateway.description: Authenticated API requests were rejected even though clients sent valid tokens. An authentication alert and gateway logs showed failures reading the verification keys.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A permissions update removed the gateway's access to its key store. Restoring read access allowed token verification to resume.

api-gateway.title: External identity tokens failed after claim format change
api-gateway.description: Users signing in through an external identity integration could not access HR APIs. Support reports and token validation logs showed a common failure for that integration.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The identity provider changed the format of a token claim that the gateway expected as a string. Updating the claim parser to accept the documented format restored access.

api-gateway.title: Scheduled route refresh left new tenants unreachable
api-gateway.description: Newly provisioned tenants received 404 errors from the API gateway. Provisioning checks detected that their routes were missing even though tenant setup had completed.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The scheduled route refresh job had stopped after an unhandled error. Restarting the job and fixing its error handling populated the missing routes.

api-gateway.title: Rate limit change blocked normal shift scheduling traffic
api-gateway.description: Managers received 429 responses while loading and updating shift schedules. Gateway rate-limit dashboards showed a sudden rise in rejected requests.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the scheduling API limit below normal usage levels. Restoring the intended threshold stopped the unnecessary rejections.

api-gateway.title: Gateway retries amplified a backend slowdown
api-gateway.description: Users saw long delays and occasional errors when viewing payslips. Traffic metrics showed the gateway sending several backend requests for each client request.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: An overly aggressive retry policy multiplied requests during a backend slowdown. Reducing retries and adding backoff relieved the load.

api-gateway.title: Large response headers caused employee API failures
api-gateway.description: Some employee profile requests failed with 502 errors despite the backend completing them. Gateway logs recorded response header size violations.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A backend update increased response header size beyond the gateway limit. Removing redundant headers and adjusting the limit restored responses.

api-gateway.title: Gateway connection pool exhausted under concurrent requests
api-gateway.description: Clock-in and clock-out API calls timed out during a traffic spike. Monitoring showed requests waiting for available upstream connections.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway's connection pool was too small for the concurrent workload. Increasing the pool limit and tuning connection reuse cleared the queue.

api-gateway.title: CORS policy blocked browser access to benefits APIs
api-gateway.description: Employees could not load benefits information in the web application, although direct API checks succeeded. Browser error reports showed cross-origin requests being blocked.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A gateway policy update omitted an allowed application origin. Restoring the origin to the CORS policy fixed browser access.

api-gateway.title: Gateway returned stale authorization decisions after role changes
api-gateway.description: Some managers retained access to team endpoints briefly after their permissions were removed. An access review and targeted API checks detected the delay.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway cached authorization decisions longer than intended and did not invalidate them on role changes. The cache lifetime and invalidation behavior were corrected.

api-gateway.title: Malformed path decoding rejected valid employee searches
api-gateway.description: Employee searches containing certain encoded characters returned 400 errors. Support reproduced the issue and gateway logs showed path decoding failures.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: A gateway update decoded request paths twice, turning valid encoded characters into invalid input. Removing the second decoding step restored searches.

api-gateway.title: Gateway health checks removed healthy scheduling backends
api-gateway.description: Shift scheduling requests intermittently returned 503 errors. Gateway health dashboards showed healthy backend instances being marked unavailable.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway health check used an endpoint that required authentication. Switching to the backend's unauthenticated health endpoint restored the upstream pool.

api-gateway.title: Gateway audit logs stopped recording API access
api-gateway.description: API requests continued to work, but administrators could not find recent access events in audit reports. A monitoring check detected that the gateway audit event stream had stopped.
api-gateway.resolution_summary: The gateway's audit log buffer filled when the logging dependency rejected oversized batches. Reducing batch size and replaying buffered events restored the stream.

auth-service.title: Employees are returned to the sign-in page after entering valid credentials
auth-service.description: Employees with valid credentials were redirected back to sign-in without reaching their workforce dashboards. Support reports and a rise in successful credential checks without completed sessions revealed the issue.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the session cookie path, so the browser did not send the cookie on the next request. The deploy was rolled back and the cookie path was corrected.

auth-service.title: Single sign-on fails for tenants using custom identity providers
auth-service.description: Employees using single sign-on saw an invalid audience error instead of reaching their HR applications. Tenant administrators reported the failures and authentication error logs confirmed the pattern.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change supplied the wrong audience value when validating identity provider responses. Restoring the expected audience resolved sign-in.

auth-service.title: Mobile sign-in fails because the authentication certificate expired
auth-service.description: Employees signing in through the mobile app received a connection error before they could enter credentials. Certificate monitoring alerted the team and synthetic sign-in checks began failing.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The certificate presented by auth-service had expired because its renewal was not applied. The team installed a valid certificate and restored automatic renewal.

auth-service.title: Sign-in requests fail while the session cache is unavailable
auth-service.description: Employees encountered an error after submitting valid credentials and could not start new sessions. Elevated session creation errors and a cache availability alert detected the problem.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The session cache was unavailable, and auth-service could not persist newly created sessions. The cache was restored and session creation recovered.

auth-service.title: Authentication requests time out during the morning sign-in surge
auth-service.description: Employees experienced long waits and timeouts when opening payroll and scheduling applications. Request latency alerts showed that the issue coincided with a sharp increase in sign-in traffic.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The auth-service worker pool was too small for the concurrent sign-in load. Increasing capacity and adjusting the worker limit cleared the backlog.

auth-service.title: Auth-service instances restart repeatedly during token refresh
auth-service.description: Employees were intermittently signed out while using the platform and had to sign in again. Restart alerts and memory graphs showed that auth-service instances were exhausting memory.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A token refresh code path retained expired session objects in memory. The team removed the retention bug and restarted the affected instances.

auth-service.title: Sign-in slows down for tenants with many former employees
auth-service.description: Employees at larger tenants waited unusually long after entering their credentials. Latency monitoring and support reports identified the affected sign-in requests.
auth-service.resolution_summary: An account lookup query scanned historical employee records because a supporting index was missing. Adding the index restored normal lookup times.

auth-service.title: Some employees cannot sign in after account records are merged
auth-service.description: Affected employees saw an account not found message even though their accounts remained visible to administrators. Support reports and mismatched account lookup records exposed the issue.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A record merge left some authentication identifiers pointing to obsolete account records. The team repaired the identifiers and corrected the merge process.

auth-service.title: Single sign-on redirects fail when identity provider hostnames do not resolve
auth-service.description: Employees attempting single sign-on saw a connection error before reaching their identity provider. DNS lookup failures in auth-service logs and external sign-in checks detected the problem.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A DNS resolver used by auth-service stopped resolving identity provider hostnames. Switching to healthy resolvers restored the redirects.

auth-service.title: Administrators cannot reset employee multi-factor authentication
auth-service.description: Administrators received a permission error when trying to reset an employee's multi-factor enrollment. Support tickets and audit logs showed that authorized administrators were affected.
auth-service.resolution_summary: An authorization policy omitted the reset action from the administrator role. Restoring that permission allowed authorized resets to complete.

auth-service.title: Social identity sign-in fails after provider response format changes
auth-service.description: Employees using an external identity provider were returned to sign-in with a generic error. A spike in provider callback failures prompted investigation.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed the format of a profile field that auth-service assumed was always a string. Updating the response parser restored sign-in.

auth-service.title: Newly hired employees cannot activate their accounts
auth-service.description: New hires saw an invalid activation link message even when using recently received invitations. Onboarding support reports and failed activation checks revealed the issue.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A scheduled cleanup job incorrectly marked pending invitations as expired. The job was corrected and affected invitations were reissued.

auth-service.title: Valid access tokens are rejected as not yet valid
auth-service.description: Employees were intermittently denied access immediately after signing in. Token validation errors increased even though the affected tokens had just been issued.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Clock drift on some auth-service instances caused token issue times to be ahead of validating instances. Restoring time synchronization resolved the errors.

auth-service.title: Employees are signed out when two refresh requests arrive together
auth-service.description: Employees working in multiple browser tabs were unexpectedly prompted to sign in again. Session logs showed pairs of refresh requests immediately before the sign-outs.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A race condition caused simultaneous refresh requests to invalidate each other's tokens. The refresh operation was made atomic so concurrent requests no longer revoke the session.

auth-service.title: Password reset forms reject valid submissions
auth-service.description: Employees following password reset links saw a form security error when submitting a new password. Failed reset metrics and support reports identified the affected flow.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A change to the reset page omitted the request verification token from the submitted form. Restoring the token allowed password resets to complete.

auth-service.title: Applications reject tokens after signing key rotation
auth-service.description: Employees could sign in but received authorization errors when opening payroll and scheduling pages. Token rejection alerts rose shortly after a signing key rotation.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Auth-service began signing tokens with a new key before publishing its public key to token validators. Publishing the key and correcting the rotation sequence restored access.

auth-service.title: One-time verification codes arrive after they expire
auth-service.description: Employees using email verification could not complete sign-in because their codes arrived too late. Delivery delay monitoring and user reports showed a growing message queue.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A notification delivery backlog delayed messages beyond the code validity period. The queue was drained and delivery capacity was increased.

auth-service.title: Deactivated employees retain active sessions longer than expected
auth-service.description: Administrators saw that recently deactivated employees could still access the platform through existing sessions. An audit check comparing account status with active sessions detected the issue.
auth-service.resolution_summary: The account deactivation event was not reaching the auth-service session revocation handler. Repairing the event subscription and revoking affected sessions closed the gap.

auth-service.title: Sign-in is blocked for employees behind shared office networks
auth-service.description: Employees in several offices received too many attempts errors despite entering correct credentials. Support reports and rate-limit logs showed that unrelated users shared the same limit.
auth-service.resolution_summary: A rate-limit configuration counted attempts by network address alone, grouping many employees together. The team adjusted the limits to account for individual sign-in attempts.

auth-service.title: Users cannot enroll a new authenticator after changing phones
auth-service.description: Employees replacing their phones received an enrollment error when setting up multi-factor authentication. Support reports and enrollment failure logs identified the affected accounts.
auth-service.resolution_summary: Old enrollment records remained in a pending state and blocked replacement enrollment. The team cleared affected pending records and fixed the state transition.

user-service.title: Employee profiles fail to open after a user-service deploy
user-service.description: Some employees saw an error when opening their profiles. The failures affected profiles without a preferred name and were detected by an increase in user-service error alerts.
user-service.resolution_summary: A deploy treated the optional preferred name field as mandatory. The change was rolled back and the field handling was corrected.

user-service.title: New employee invitations expire immediately
user-service.description: New hires could not accept invitations because the links appeared expired. Support reports and a drop in successful invitation acceptance exposed the issue.
user-service.resolution_summary: An invitation lifetime setting was changed from hours to seconds. The setting was corrected and affected invitations were reissued.

user-service.title: User-service cannot connect to the employee directory
user-service.description: Employee profile changes stopped syncing to the directory. A growing sync backlog and connection errors alerted the operations team.
user-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by user-service to authenticate to the directory had expired. The certificate was renewed and queued changes were replayed.

user-service.title: Single sign-on fails for employees using an external identity provider
user-service.description: Employees attempting single sign-on were returned to the login page without being signed in. User-service login failure alerts and customer reports showed that the failures affected one identity provider.
user-service.resolution_summary: The identity provider was unavailable, so user-service could not validate login responses. Sign-in recovered when the provider restored its service.

user-service.title: Bulk user updates cause user-service restarts
user-service.description: Administrators saw bulk profile updates stop partway through, and some employees experienced intermittent profile errors. Memory alerts showed user-service instances restarting during large updates.
user-service.resolution_summary: The bulk update handler loaded entire files into memory at once. Processing was changed to use bounded batches.

user-service.title: Employee directory searches take too long to return
user-service.description: Managers searching large employee directories saw long waits and occasional timeouts. Slow-query alerts and support reports identified the problem.
user-service.resolution_summary: A directory search query scanned the user table because it lacked an appropriate index. Adding the index and adjusting the query restored normal response times.

user-service.title: Some managers lose access to their team profiles
user-service.description: Managers could no longer view profiles for employees who reported to them. Access-denied reports and a comparison with the reporting hierarchy revealed missing relationships.
user-service.resolution_summary: A failed data repair had removed some manager-to-employee mappings. The mappings were restored from the authoritative hierarchy and the repair procedure was corrected.

user-service.title: User-service intermittently fails to resolve the notification service
user-service.description: Invitation and account recovery messages were delayed because user-service could not reach the notification service. DNS errors in user-service logs and a growing message backlog exposed the failure.
user-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change caused intermittent resolution failures. The previous configuration was restored and pending messages were sent.

user-service.title: Administrators cannot deactivate employee accounts
user-service.description: Administrators received permission errors when attempting to deactivate users. Support reports and access-denied logs showed the failure across multiple tenants.
user-service.resolution_summary: The user-service service account had lost permission to update account status records. Restoring the permission allowed deactivations to complete.

user-service.title: Provisioned users are missing department assignments
user-service.description: Users created through automated provisioning appeared without departments in the employee directory. Administrators noticed the missing assignments and user-service logs showed rejected department fields.
user-service.resolution_summary: A provisioning provider changed the format of its department attribute. User-service was updated to accept the new format and affected records were resynced.

user-service.title: Departed employees remain active after scheduled deactivation
user-service.description: Accounts scheduled for deactivation remained active beyond their departure time. A reconciliation alert detected a growing number of overdue deactivations.
user-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled deactivation job stopped after encountering a malformed record. The record was corrected, the backlog was processed, and per-record error handling was added.

user-service.title: Profile changes do not reach downstream services
user-service.description: Employees could save profile changes, but other platform features continued to show old information. A growing event queue and reports of inconsistent names revealed the issue.
user-service.resolution_summary: A malformed event caused the user-service event consumer to repeatedly retry the same message. The event was isolated and the consumer was updated to handle invalid messages.

user-service.title: Employee directory shows stale role assignments
user-service.description: Administrators saw old roles in the directory after saving role changes. Support reports and cache comparison checks confirmed that the updates had reached the database but not the displayed results.
user-service.resolution_summary: Role changes did not invalidate the user-service directory cache. Cache invalidation was added and stale entries were cleared.

user-service.title: Duplicate invitations are sent to newly added employees
user-service.description: Some new employees received two invitations and administrators saw duplicate pending entries. Customer reports led the team to inspect concurrent invitation requests.
user-service.resolution_summary: Two requests could create invitations before either checked for an existing pending entry. A uniqueness constraint and safe retry handling were added.

user-service.title: Employees cannot enroll a second authentication factor
user-service.description: Employees attempting to set up multi-factor authentication saw an error after scanning the setup code. A drop in enrollment completions and user-service validation errors alerted the team.
user-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change made the verification window too narrow for devices with slightly different clock settings. The supported window was restored.

user-service.title: Password reset links fail near the end of their validity period
user-service.description: Some employees were told their password reset links had expired even though they had recently requested them. Support reports and timestamp comparisons exposed the inconsistent expiry checks.
user-service.resolution_summary: User-service compared timestamps using different time zones when creating and validating reset links. Both checks were changed to use the same time standard.

user-service.title: Legitimate login attempts are blocked by the user-service rate limiter
user-service.description: Employees sharing an office network were temporarily blocked from signing in. A spike in rate-limit responses and reports from several workplaces identified the issue.
user-service.resolution_summary: The limiter counted all requests from a shared network address against one small limit. The policy was adjusted to include account-level signals while retaining abuse protection.

user-service.title: Manager changes fail when several administrators edit the same team
user-service.description: Some manager assignments could not be saved during concurrent team updates. Database deadlock alerts and administrator reports showed that the affected updates had been rolled back.
user-service.resolution_summary: User-service transactions locked employee records in inconsistent order. The update path was changed to acquire locks consistently and retry transient conflicts.

user-service.title: Employees cannot upload profile photos
user-service.description: Profile photo uploads failed while other profile edits continued to work. Upload error alerts and employee reports pointed to the photo storage path.
user-service.resolution_summary: The storage allocation used for profile photos had reached its limit. Capacity was increased and unused temporary uploads were removed.

user-service.title: Employee directory skips users when administrators browse pages
user-service.description: Administrators browsing the directory could not find some employees even though direct searches returned them. A customer report and pagination tests revealed that entries were skipped between pages.
user-service.resolution_summary: Pagination used a non-unique sort field, causing records with the same name to move across page boundaries. A stable secondary sort key was added.

payroll-service.title: Overtime pay is understated after a payroll calculation release
payroll-service.description: Some employees received less overtime pay than expected in payroll previews. A payroll administrator noticed that overtime hours were being multiplied by the base hourly rate.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A code change applied the overtime multiplier after rounding the rate to zero. The change was rolled back, the calculation was corrected, and affected payrolls were recalculated.

payroll-service.title: Payroll previews time out for large workforces
payroll-service.description: Payroll administrators for large workforces could not complete payroll previews. The issue was detected when preview latency and timeout alerts increased.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A missing database index caused the employee earnings query to scan historical records. Adding the index and limiting the query to the current pay period restored preview performance.

payroll-service.title: Bank payment files fail to reach the payment processor
payroll-service.description: Approved payrolls remained pending because their bank payment files could not be delivered. Support detected the problem after administrators reported missing delivery confirmations.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used for the payment processor connection had expired. The certificate was renewed and the queued files were sent after checking that none had already been delivered.

payroll-service.title: Tax withholding calculations fail during payroll processing
payroll-service.description: Payroll runs could not calculate withholding for affected employees and remained incomplete. An alert showed a sharp increase in errors from the tax calculation dependency.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The external tax calculation service was unavailable. Once it recovered, failed calculations were retried and the affected payroll runs completed.

payroll-service.title: Large payroll exports stop before completing
payroll-service.description: Administrators downloading detailed payroll exports received incomplete files or errors. Memory usage alerts identified repeated restarts of the export workers.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The export process loaded all rows into memory before writing the file. The worker was changed to stream rows in batches, preventing memory exhaustion.

payroll-service.title: Payroll submissions are rejected before the configured cutoff
payroll-service.description: Administrators were told that the submission window had closed while they still expected to submit payroll. Support identified the issue after receiving reports from several tenants.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the cutoff interval in hours instead of minutes. The value was corrected and affected payroll submissions were reopened.

payroll-service.title: Payroll service cannot resolve the payment gateway
payroll-service.description: Payment initiation failed for payrolls that had already been approved. Connection alerts showed that payroll-service could not resolve the gateway hostname.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration update removed the required gateway record. Restoring the record allowed payment requests to resume.

payroll-service.title: Payslips cannot be downloaded after payroll completes
payroll-service.description: Employees received errors when opening newly generated payslips. The problem was detected through download failure alerts and employee reports.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change prevented payroll-service from reading payslip files in object storage. Restoring the read permission made the existing files available again.

payroll-service.title: New employee tax registrations are rejected by the filing provider
payroll-service.description: Payroll administrators could not submit tax registrations for newly hired employees. The integration error rate rose immediately after the filing provider changed its request format.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The provider required a new field that payroll-service did not send. The integration was updated to include the field, and rejected registrations were resubmitted.

payroll-service.title: Recurring deductions are missing from payroll previews
payroll-service.description: Some payroll previews omitted employees' recurring benefit deductions. An administrator noticed the discrepancy while comparing the preview with the previous payroll.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job that stages recurring deductions had stopped after encountering an invalid record. The record was corrected, the job was made resilient to individual record failures, and the deductions were restaged.

payroll-service.title: Employee bank account changes fail validation
payroll-service.description: Some employees could not save changes to their direct deposit details. Support found that affected records failed validation even when the new details were valid.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A failed migration had left malformed bank account metadata on a subset of employee records. The metadata was repaired and the migration was corrected.

payroll-service.title: Payroll approval notifications arrive several hours late
payroll-service.description: Administrators received approval notifications long after payrolls were ready for review. Queue age monitoring detected the growing delay.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: Notification workers were processing a backlog after their concurrency limit was reduced incorrectly. The limit was restored and the backlog drained.

payroll-service.title: Retried payroll payments create duplicate payment instructions
payroll-service.description: A small number of employees received duplicate payment instructions after payroll submissions were retried. Reconciliation detected more payment instructions than expected for the affected payrolls.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: Retries used new idempotency tokens when the processor response timed out. Retry handling was fixed to reuse the original token, and duplicate instructions were cancelled or recovered where possible.

payroll-service.title: Work hours near a clock change appear in the wrong pay period
payroll-service.description: Some employees' hours were included in the wrong payroll period after a local clock change. A payroll administrator detected the mismatch while reviewing time records.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The pay-period boundary calculation used a fixed offset instead of the employee's time zone. The boundary calculation was corrected and affected payroll previews were refreshed.

payroll-service.title: Payroll runs stall when adjustments are submitted concurrently
payroll-service.description: Administrators saw payroll runs remain in progress after submitting several adjustments at once. Database lock alerts identified transactions waiting on one another.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: Adjustment transactions acquired employee and payroll locks in inconsistent order. The lock order was made consistent and stalled runs were retried.

payroll-service.title: Updated pay rates are not reflected in payroll previews
payroll-service.description: Some previews continued to use an employee's previous pay rate after an administrator saved a new rate. The discrepancy was detected during a preview review.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: Pay rate updates did not invalidate the calculation cache. Cache invalidation was added and affected previews were recalculated.

payroll-service.title: Payroll approvals fail when audit log storage fills
payroll-service.description: Administrators could review payroll but received an error when approving it. Monitoring showed that the audit log volume had run out of space.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: Audit records were not being archived because the retention task had stopped. Storage was recovered and the retention task was repaired, allowing approvals to proceed.

payroll-service.title: Off-cycle payroll option disappears for eligible administrators
payroll-service.description: Eligible administrators could not start off-cycle payrolls from payroll-service. Support detected the issue after reports from tenants that regularly used the option.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A feature flag change disabled the option for an incorrect group of tenants. The flag rules were corrected and the option returned.

payroll-service.title: Payroll history fails to load for employees with many pay statements
payroll-service.description: Some employees saw an error instead of their payroll history. Error monitoring showed that requests for employees with long histories exceeded the response size limit.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: The history endpoint returned every pay statement in a single response. Pagination was added so payroll history could load in smaller batches.

payroll-service.title: Garnishment amounts are omitted from payroll calculation
payroll-service.description: Payroll previews omitted active garnishments for some employees. The issue was detected when a payroll administrator compared deductions against active orders.
payroll-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration left the active status of some garnishment orders unset. The affected records were repaired and the migration was updated to preserve the status.

timesheet-service.title: Employees could not submit timesheets with unpaid breaks
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw a validation error when submitting timesheets that contained unpaid breaks. Managers could not approve the affected submissions. Support reports and a rise in submission errors revealed the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced a validation rule that treated unpaid breaks as paid hours. Rolling back the change restored submissions.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet totals shifted across pay periods
timesheet-service.description: Some employees saw hours assigned to the wrong pay period when shifts crossed midnight. Payroll administrators noticed discrepancies while reviewing period totals. The affected entries had been grouped using the wrong time zone.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change made timesheet-service use a default time zone instead of each tenant's configured time zone. Restoring tenant-specific time zone handling and recalculating affected totals fixed the issue.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet approvals failed after a certificate expired
timesheet-service.description: Managers received an error when approving submitted timesheets. Approval requests could not reach the employee directory to verify manager assignments. Connection error alerts detected the failure.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by timesheet-service to connect to the employee directory had expired. Replacing the certificate restored approval checks.

timesheet-service.title: Employees could not open timesheets during identity service outage
timesheet-service.description: Employees were unable to open their timesheets and saw authentication errors. Existing timesheet data remained intact, but users could not view or edit it. Login failure alerts and support reports identified the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: An outage in the identity dependency prevented timesheet-service from validating sessions. Access recovered when the dependency was restored.

timesheet-service.title: Large timesheet exports exhausted service memory
timesheet-service.description: Payroll administrators saw exports fail for tenants with many timesheet entries. Some other requests were delayed while export workers restarted. Memory alerts showed repeated exhaustion during export generation.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Export workers loaded all matching entries into memory at once. Streaming entries in batches reduced memory use and allowed large exports to complete.

timesheet-service.title: Manager approval queue loaded slowly
timesheet-service.description: Managers waited a long time for the pending approval list to appear. Some requests timed out before managers could review submitted hours. Latency alerts and slow query logs exposed the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The approval queue query scanned timesheet entries without an appropriate index. Adding the index and updating the query restored normal response times.

timesheet-service.title: Duplicate entries appeared on some employee timesheets
timesheet-service.description: Some employees saw the same shift twice on their timesheets and reported inflated totals. The discrepancy was found during payroll review and confirmed in the stored entries. Affected timesheets required correction before approval.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A data repair process copied some entries without checking whether they already existed. The duplicate records were removed and the repair process was changed to prevent repeat insertion.

timesheet-service.title: Clock-in events stopped appearing on timesheets
timesheet-service.description: Employees could clock in, but the resulting entries did not appear in timesheet-service. Managers saw incomplete hours until the backlog was processed. A growing event backlog triggered an alert.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration error prevented timesheet-service from reaching the event broker. Correcting the DNS record restored the connection and allowed queued events to be processed.

timesheet-service.title: Managers could not view their team's timesheets
timesheet-service.description: Managers saw an access denied message when opening their team timesheet list. Employees could still view their own entries, but approvals were delayed. Support reports identified the access problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the team-view capability from the manager role. Restoring the capability returned access without changing employee permissions.

timesheet-service.title: Payroll export rejected overtime codes
timesheet-service.description: Payroll administrators received rejected exports for timesheets containing overtime. Regular hours exported successfully, but affected payroll batches required manual review. The rejection rate alert and administrator reports revealed the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A payroll provider changed the accepted format for overtime codes in its API. Updating the export mapping to the new format fixed the rejections.

timesheet-service.title: Missing-timesheet reminders were not sent
timesheet-service.description: Employees did not receive reminders to submit incomplete timesheets. Managers noticed an unusually large number of unsubmitted timesheets during review. Monitoring then showed that the reminder job had not completed.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job stopped after encountering an employee record with a missing locale. Handling that record safely and rerunning the job restored reminders.

timesheet-service.title: Concurrent edits overwrote timesheet notes
timesheet-service.description: Employees and managers sometimes found that their notes disappeared after editing the same timesheet. The hours remained correct, but the missing explanations complicated approval. Support reproduced the issue using simultaneous edits.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Timesheet-service saved the entire record without checking whether it had changed since it was loaded. Adding version checks prevented silent overwrites and prompted users to refresh.

timesheet-service.title: Approved timesheets remained locked after reopening
timesheet-service.description: Managers reopened approved timesheets, but employees still could not edit them. The interface continued to show the entries as locked. Support reports and cache inspection identified the stale state.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The reopen operation did not invalidate the cached approval status. Invalidating that cache entry restored editing immediately after reopening.

timesheet-service.title: Employees received duplicate timesheet submission notifications
timesheet-service.description: Employees received multiple confirmations for a single timesheet submission. The timesheets themselves were submitted only once, but users were unsure whether they needed to take further action. Notification volume alerts revealed the increase.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The notification consumer retried messages after sending them without recording completion. Adding an idempotency check stopped duplicate notifications.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet attachments failed to upload
timesheet-service.description: Employees could not attach supporting documents to timesheet entries. Timesheet edits without attachments continued to work, but affected submissions needed documents added later. Upload failure alerts detected the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The attachment storage allocation had reached its limit. Increasing the allocation and removing unneeded temporary files restored uploads.

timesheet-service.title: Break durations were calculated incorrectly during clock changes
timesheet-service.description: Some timesheets showed incorrect break durations for shifts spanning a daylight saving time change. Managers found mismatches between recorded breaks and calculated paid hours. Payroll review reports exposed the discrepancy.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The duration calculation subtracted local clock values instead of comparing actual instants. Correcting the calculation and recalculating affected entries fixed the totals.

timesheet-service.title: Timesheet history failed to load after a schema migration
timesheet-service.description: Employees saw an error when opening older timesheet history. Current timesheets remained available, but users could not check prior entries. Application error alerts detected the failures.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration removed a field still used by the history reader. Restoring a compatible field and updating the reader brought history back.

timesheet-service.title: Approved hours were missing from payroll exports
timesheet-service.description: Some payroll exports contained fewer approved hours than the review screen showed. Administrators found the discrepancy while reconciling export totals. The affected entries remained visible in timesheet-service.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: The export pagination logic skipped entries when multiple records shared the same sort value. Using a stable secondary sort key ensured every approved entry was included.

timesheet-service.title: Bulk approval requests stalled for large teams
timesheet-service.description: Managers approving many timesheets at once saw requests hang or fail. Some approvals completed while others remained pending, requiring managers to check each result. Database lock alerts and support reports identified the issue.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: Bulk approval transactions acquired timesheet locks in inconsistent order, causing deadlocks. Processing records in a consistent order and retrying deadlocked transactions resolved the failures.

timesheet-service.title: New employees could not select projects on timesheet entries
timesheet-service.description: New employees saw an empty project list when adding timesheet entries. They could save unassigned time but could not allocate it to projects. Support reports and project lookup errors revealed the problem.
timesheet-service.resolution_summary: A rate limit on the project directory was reached because timesheet-service requested the full project list separately for each employee. Batching lookups and caching shared results restored project selection.

benefits-service.title: Employees see blank benefit plan comparisons
benefits-service.description: Employees opening the plan comparison page saw empty columns instead of coverage and cost details. The issue affected enrollment decisions and was detected through an increase in client-side errors.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the plan response format without updating the comparison renderer. The deploy was rolled back and the response contract was corrected.

benefits-service.title: New hires cannot enroll in medical coverage
benefits-service.description: New hires received an eligibility error when selecting medical coverage. Support noticed a spike in enrollment failures shortly after an eligibility policy update.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change excluded employees whose start date matched the beginning of their eligibility window. The policy was corrected and affected employees were allowed to enroll.

benefits-service.title: Carrier enrollment submissions fail certificate validation
benefits-service.description: Completed benefit elections remained pending instead of reaching the carrier. An alert on the carrier submission queue detected the growing backlog.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate carrier submissions had expired. A replacement certificate was installed and queued submissions were retried.

benefits-service.title: Benefit deductions are missing from payroll exports
benefits-service.description: Payroll administrators found that some benefit deductions were absent from their export files. The discrepancy was detected during a routine reconciliation of elections against export totals.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A dependency that supplies payroll deduction codes was unavailable during export generation, and the export omitted entries without codes. The dependency recovered and the affected exports were regenerated.

benefits-service.title: Open enrollment pages return errors under peak traffic
benefits-service.description: Employees encountered errors when loading available benefit plans during open enrollment. Monitoring showed that benefits-service instances were exhausting memory as traffic increased.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: Plan responses were being held in memory without a size limit. The cache was bounded and service capacity was increased.

benefits-service.title: Dependent verification takes several minutes to load
benefits-service.description: Administrators experienced long delays when opening dependent verification requests. Slow-request alerts identified the verification list as the source of the delays.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the full dependent document table for each request. An index was added and the query was revised to use it.

benefits-service.title: Employee coverage levels change after a profile update
benefits-service.description: Some employees saw their coverage level revert after updating personal information. Support reports and an audit of election history revealed the unexpected changes.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A profile synchronization process overwrote current elections with stale values. The synchronization logic was corrected and affected elections were restored from audit records.

benefits-service.title: Benefit plan documents cannot be downloaded
benefits-service.description: Employees received download errors when opening plan documents from benefits-service. Synthetic checks detected that document storage requests could not resolve their destination.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change pointed the storage hostname to an invalid resolver. The resolver configuration was corrected and document downloads recovered.

benefits-service.title: Benefits administrators cannot approve life event changes
benefits-service.description: Administrators received permission errors when approving employee life event requests. The problem was detected through support reports and authorization error logs.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A role update removed the approval permission from the benefits administrator role. The permission was restored and pending requests were processed.

benefits-service.title: Dental carrier rejects dependent enrollment submissions
benefits-service.description: Dental elections with dependents remained pending after employees submitted them. A carrier rejection alert identified the affected submissions.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The carrier changed the accepted format for dependent relationship values. The integration was updated and rejected submissions were resubmitted.

benefits-service.title: Expired benefits remain active after termination
benefits-service.description: Some terminated employees continued to appear as actively covered in benefits-service. A reconciliation report identified coverage records that should have ended.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled coverage termination job stopped after encountering an invalid record. The job was changed to isolate invalid records, and missed terminations were processed.

benefits-service.title: Benefit election confirmation emails are not sent
benefits-service.description: Employees completed elections but did not receive confirmation messages. The notification queue alert showed an increasing number of undelivered messages.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A malformed message template caused the notification worker to reject confirmation requests. The template was corrected and queued confirmations were sent.

benefits-service.title: Health savings account contributions are rounded incorrectly
benefits-service.description: Employees saw contribution amounts differ by a cent from the amounts they entered. A payroll reconciliation check detected mismatches between elections and deduction records.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A calculation converted decimal amounts through floating-point values before rounding. Decimal arithmetic was introduced and affected deduction records were corrected.

benefits-service.title: Benefit enrollment deadline is displayed in the wrong time zone
benefits-service.description: Employees in some locations saw enrollment deadlines that differed from their actual cutoff. Support identified the issue after employees reported being locked out before the displayed deadline.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The deadline display used the browser time zone while the enrollment cutoff used the tenant's configured time zone. The display was aligned with the cutoff and affected enrollment windows were reviewed.

benefits-service.title: Benefit plan changes create duplicate carrier submissions
benefits-service.description: Some employees received duplicate coverage confirmations after changing their elections. A carrier reconciliation report showed repeated submissions for the same change.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A retry after a request timeout created a second submission because the integration lacked an idempotency check. Deduplication was added and duplicate carrier records were corrected.

benefits-service.title: Benefits dashboard shows another employee's dependent names
benefits-service.description: Some administrators saw dependent names that did not belong to the employee whose record they opened. The issue was detected through a support report and investigation of dashboard responses.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: A shared cache used an incomplete key that did not distinguish employee records. The cache was cleared and its key was changed to include the employee identifier.

benefits-service.title: Benefits-service rejects valid coverage tier updates
benefits-service.description: Administrators could not save certain coverage tier changes and saw a validation error. Error monitoring detected a rise in rejected update requests.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The validation rules had not been updated to recognize a newly configured coverage tier. The rules were updated and the rejected changes were resubmitted.

benefits-service.title: Benefit enrollment imports stop partway through large files
benefits-service.description: Administrators found that large enrollment imports contained only the first portion of their records. Import completion checks detected a mismatch between submitted and processed row counts.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The import worker reached its execution time limit before processing the full file. Processing was split into resumable batches and incomplete imports were rerun.

benefits-service.title: Employees see outdated benefit plan premiums
benefits-service.description: Employees viewed old premium amounts after administrators updated plan rates. A comparison of the administrator view and enrollment page exposed the discrepancy.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The rate update process failed to invalidate cached plan pricing. Cache invalidation was added and the stale prices were cleared.

benefits-service.title: Benefit eligibility checks fail for employees on leave
benefits-service.description: Employees returning from leave could not view plans for which they were eligible. Support reports led to an investigation of eligibility decisions.
benefits-service.resolution_summary: The eligibility rule treated a return-from-leave status as an inactive employment status. The rule was corrected and eligibility was recalculated for affected employees.

payments-api.title: Payroll payment requests fail after a deployment
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators saw payment submissions fail immediately after approval. Employees did not receive the affected payouts until submissions were retried. Error-rate monitoring detected the increase in rejected requests.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incompatible change to the payment request schema. The release was rolled back and affected submissions were safely retried.

payments-api.title: Bank transfers rejected by an incorrect currency configuration
payments-api.description: Payments-api rejected valid payroll transfers in a supported currency. Payroll administrators saw validation errors when submitting payment batches. Support reports and a rise in validation failures exposed the problem.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A configuration change removed the currency from the allowed list. Restoring the correct configuration allowed the affected batches to be submitted.

payments-api.title: Expired certificate prevents payments-api from connecting to the bank
payments-api.description: Payroll transfers remained pending because payments-api could not establish a connection to the bank gateway. Administrators saw batches stuck in processing. Connection failure alerts detected the issue.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The client certificate used for the bank connection had expired. A renewed certificate was installed and pending transfers were resubmitted after their status was verified.

payments-api.title: Bank gateway outage delays payroll transfer submissions
payments-api.description: Payroll administrators could approve batches, but payments-api could not send transfers to the bank gateway. Payments remained queued and employees received them later than expected. Dependency health checks and queue-depth alerts identified the delay.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The bank gateway was unavailable. Payments-api resumed submission when the gateway recovered, and the queue was drained without creating duplicate transfers.

payments-api.title: Large payment batches exhaust payments-api memory
payments-api.description: Large payroll batches intermittently failed while payments-api was preparing transfers. Administrators had to retry affected batches, delaying payouts. Memory alerts and repeated process restarts revealed the issue.
payments-api.resolution_summary: Batch preparation loaded every transfer into memory at once. The service was changed to process transfers in bounded chunks.

payments-api.title: Payment history requests time out for large tenants
payments-api.description: Administrators with extensive payroll histories saw payment history pages fail to load. They could not readily verify earlier transfers. Request latency alerts and slow-query monitoring detected the problem.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the full payment history because it lacked an appropriate index. Adding the index and limiting result pages restored response times.

payments-api.title: Corrupted beneficiary records block payroll payouts
payments-api.description: Some payroll transfers failed because payments-api could not read their beneficiary records. Employees associated with those records did not receive their scheduled payouts until the records were repaired. Repeated data parsing errors alerted the operations team.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A migration wrote malformed beneficiary data for a subset of records. The affected records were restored from verified source data and the failed transfers were retried.

payments-api.title: DNS resolution failures interrupt bank transfer submission
payments-api.description: Payments-api intermittently failed to reach the bank gateway when submitting transfers. Payroll batches remained pending and payout completion was delayed. Network monitoring showed repeated name resolution failures.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A resolver configuration change sent bank gateway lookups to an unreachable DNS server. Correcting the resolver configuration restored connectivity and queued transfers were processed.

payments-api.title: Restricted database permissions prevent payment status updates
payments-api.description: Transfers were sent to the bank, but their status remained stuck in processing in the payroll interface. Administrators could not tell whether payouts had completed. Database permission errors triggered an alert.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the service account's ability to update payment records. The permission was restored and statuses were reconciled against bank responses.

payments-api.title: Bank API response change causes transfer status checks to fail
payments-api.description: Payments-api stopped updating the status of some bank transfers. Administrators saw payments remain pending even after they had completed. A spike in response parsing errors revealed the problem.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The bank API introduced a new status value that payments-api did not recognize. The parser was updated to handle the value, and affected transfers were reconciled.

payments-api.title: Failed reconciliation job leaves completed payments marked pending
payments-api.description: Completed payroll transfers continued to appear as pending in the payment history. Administrators spent extra time confirming payout status. Monitoring detected that the scheduled reconciliation job had not completed.
payments-api.resolution_summary: An unhandled empty settlement file caused the job to exit before processing later files. The job was corrected and rerun to update the affected statuses.

payments-api.title: Bank webhooks rejected due to signature verification error
payments-api.description: Payments-api rejected valid bank notifications, leaving transfer statuses out of date. Administrators could not rely on payment history to confirm completion. Webhook rejection alerts detected the problem.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The service verified signatures against a modified version of the request body rather than the original bytes. Verification was corrected and missed notifications were recovered through reconciliation.

payments-api.title: Fractional-hour payroll payouts rounded to the wrong amount
payments-api.description: Some employee payouts differed from the approved payroll amount by a cent. Payroll administrators noticed the discrepancy during payout review. A comparison between approved totals and submitted transfers confirmed the impact.
payments-api.resolution_summary: Payments-api rounded intermediate currency conversions instead of rounding only the final amount. The calculation was corrected and adjustments were issued for affected payouts.

payments-api.title: Concurrent payment updates deadlock during batch submission
payments-api.description: Some payroll batches failed or took much longer than usual to submit. Administrators saw intermittent errors and had to retry affected batches. Database deadlock alerts identified the failure.
payments-api.resolution_summary: Concurrent workers acquired payment and batch row locks in different orders. The update logic was changed to acquire locks consistently, and failed batches were retried.

payments-api.title: Malformed queue message blocks later payment submissions
payments-api.description: Newly approved payroll payments accumulated without being submitted. Administrators saw batches remain queued longer than expected. Queue age monitoring detected the growing backlog.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A malformed message repeatedly crashed a consumer before it could process later messages. The message was isolated and the consumer was updated to quarantine invalid messages.

payments-api.title: Repeated submission creates duplicate payroll transfers
payments-api.description: A small number of employees received duplicate payouts after administrators retried payment requests. The duplicates were discovered during reconciliation of submitted transfers. Affected administrators had to arrange recovery of the extra funds.
payments-api.resolution_summary: An idempotency record expired before a delayed retry arrived, allowing the retry to create a second transfer. The retention period was extended and duplicate checks were added before bank submission.

payments-api.title: Payment submissions rejected by an overly strict rate limit
payments-api.description: Large payroll runs received rate-limit errors even though individual administrators submitted batches normally. Some payouts were delayed while batches were retried. A sudden increase in rate-limit responses triggered an alert.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A shared rate limit was applied across all tenants instead of separately per tenant. The limit was corrected and affected batches were resubmitted.

payments-api.title: Stale payment reads show completed transfers as unpaid
payments-api.description: Administrators saw some completed payroll transfers displayed as unpaid shortly after submission. This caused uncertainty about whether another payment attempt was needed. Status mismatches were detected by a consistency check.
payments-api.resolution_summary: Payment status reads were served from a database replica that had fallen behind. Status reads were moved to the primary database until replication recovered, and replica lag alerting was improved.

payments-api.title: Bank rejects payout files containing accented beneficiary names
payments-api.description: Payroll batches containing certain beneficiary names were rejected by the bank. Affected employees received their payouts late. Bank rejection reports revealed a common file-format error.
payments-api.resolution_summary: The payout file generator used an encoding that the bank did not accept. The generator was changed to produce the required encoding and rejected batches were resubmitted.

payments-api.title: Refund requests fail when original payment reference is missing
payments-api.description: Administrators could not issue refunds for some reversed payroll funding payments. They saw a generic processing error instead of a completed refund. Refund failure alerts and support reports exposed the issue.
payments-api.resolution_summary: A payment reversal path failed to retain the bank reference needed for a refund. The reference was recovered from bank records, the affected refunds were processed, and the reversal path was fixed.

billing-service.title: Subscription upgrades charged twice
billing-service.description: Customers upgrading their workforce management plans saw two charges for the same change. billing-service detected the issue when duplicate charge alerts increased after a release.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A deployment removed the idempotency check from the upgrade flow. The release was rolled back and duplicate charges were refunded.

billing-service.title: New invoices showed the wrong tax rate
billing-service.description: Some customers received invoices with an incorrect tax amount for their billing region. Support reports led the billing-service team to compare invoices with the configured tax table.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change mapped two regions to the wrong tax rates. The mapping was corrected and affected invoices were reissued.

billing-service.title: Card payments failed after gateway certificate expired
billing-service.description: Customers could not pay outstanding invoices by card because billing-service could not establish a secure connection to the payment gateway. Connection failure alerts revealed the problem.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used by billing-service had expired. Renewing and deploying the certificate restored payment processing.

billing-service.title: Invoice payments remained pending during gateway outage
billing-service.description: Customers saw invoice payments remain pending after submitting them. billing-service detected an increase in gateway errors, and the payment provider confirmed an outage.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The payment gateway was unavailable and did not return transaction results. After it recovered, billing-service reconciled the pending transactions before retrying any unpaid invoices.

billing-service.title: Invoice generation stopped under heavy batch load
billing-service.description: Some customers did not receive their scheduled invoices because billing-service workers stopped processing the queue. Memory alerts and a growing invoice backlog exposed the failure.
billing-service.resolution_summary: Invoice workers held rendered documents in memory longer than necessary and exhausted available memory. The workers were updated to release documents promptly, and the backlog was processed.

billing-service.title: Billing history page timed out for large accounts
billing-service.description: Administrators with long billing histories could not load their invoice lists. billing-service request latency alerts identified the issue.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The invoice history query scanned the full transaction table for each request. Adding an index and limiting the query to the requested page restored response times.

billing-service.title: Canceled subscriptions appeared active on invoices
billing-service.description: Some customers were billed for subscriptions they had already canceled. A billing-service reconciliation report showed a mismatch between cancellation records and invoice line items.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A corrupted subscription status field caused invoice generation to treat canceled plans as active. The affected records were repaired and incorrect charges were credited.

billing-service.title: Payment gateway hostname failed to resolve
billing-service.description: Card payments failed because billing-service could not connect to the payment gateway. Network alerts showed repeated DNS lookup failures.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A resolver configuration change sent gateway lookups to an unavailable DNS server. Restoring the resolver configuration allowed payment requests to resume.

billing-service.title: Invoice PDFs could not be downloaded
billing-service.description: Customers saw an error when trying to download invoice PDFs from billing-service. Support reports and document access errors revealed the problem.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the service account's access to stored invoice documents. Restoring read access made the PDFs available again.

billing-service.title: New payment methods could not be saved
billing-service.description: Customers attempting to add a card received a generic error and had to keep their existing payment method. billing-service detected an increase in rejected requests to the payment provider.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed a required field in its card tokenization API. Updating the request format restored card enrollment.

billing-service.title: Monthly subscription invoices were not created
billing-service.description: Customers did not receive expected subscription invoices, and their account balances remained unchanged. A billing-service job monitor detected that the invoice scheduler had not completed.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job failed when it encountered an account with a missing billing address and did not continue to other accounts. The job was changed to isolate invalid accounts, and eligible invoices were generated.

billing-service.title: Employee count changes produced incorrect subscription charges
billing-service.description: Some customers were charged for more employee seats than their plans allowed. billing-service reconciliation checks found discrepancies between billed seats and active employee counts.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The seat calculation included archived employee records. The calculation was corrected and affected customers received credits.

billing-service.title: Usage-based charges were missing from invoices
billing-service.description: Some invoices omitted charges for metered workforce features, leaving customer balances lower than expected. billing-service detected the gap when usage totals did not match invoice totals.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A queue consumer acknowledged usage events before saving them, causing events to be lost after worker restarts. The consumer was fixed and missing usage was rebuilt from source records.

billing-service.title: Payment receipts were sent to the wrong billing contact
billing-service.description: Some customers did not receive receipts, while former billing contacts received them instead. Support reports prompted billing-service to inspect receipt delivery records.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The receipt sender cached billing contact details without invalidating them after updates. Cache invalidation was added and affected customers were notified.

billing-service.title: Refunds appeared successful but were not submitted
billing-service.description: Administrators saw refunds marked as complete even though customers had not received the money. billing-service reconciliation against gateway records exposed the mismatch.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The refund flow marked requests complete before receiving confirmation from the gateway. The status transition was corrected and unsubmitted refunds were processed.

billing-service.title: Annual plan renewals used outdated prices
billing-service.description: Some customers were billed at a previous price when their annual plans renewed. billing-service pricing checks detected differences between renewal invoices and current contract terms.
billing-service.resolution_summary: The renewal process read a superseded price snapshot instead of the active contract price. The price lookup was fixed and affected invoices were adjusted.

billing-service.title: Billing dashboard showed negative outstanding balances
billing-service.description: Administrators saw negative balances even when their accounts had unpaid invoices. billing-service detected the issue through balance consistency checks.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A credit application bug subtracted the same credit twice from the displayed balance. The calculation was corrected and balances were recalculated.

billing-service.title: Invoice emails were delayed by a stalled delivery queue
billing-service.description: Customers could view newly issued invoices in billing-service but did not receive invoice emails. Queue age alerts showed that notification delivery had stopped.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A malformed email event repeatedly blocked the queue consumer. The event was removed, validation was added, and queued notifications were sent.

billing-service.title: Currency conversion rounded small charges incorrectly
billing-service.description: Customers paying in a converted currency saw invoice totals differ from the sum of their displayed line items. billing-service audit checks flagged the rounding discrepancies.
billing-service.resolution_summary: Conversion rounded each intermediate calculation inconsistently with the displayed line items. The rounding rules were aligned and affected invoices were corrected.

billing-service.title: Billing portal rejected valid administrator sessions
billing-service.description: Billing administrators were redirected to sign in repeatedly when opening the billing portal. billing-service authentication error alerts detected the increase in rejected sessions.
billing-service.resolution_summary: A clock synchronization failure made valid session tokens appear expired. Restoring time synchronization allowed administrators to access the portal.

checkout-service.title: Checkout fails when purchasing a payroll add-on
checkout-service.description: Administrators saw an error when submitting orders that included the payroll add-on. Other subscription purchases continued to work. Support reports and a rise in checkout errors exposed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incorrect product type mapping for payroll add-ons. The mapping was corrected and the deployment was rolled back.

checkout-service.title: Annual subscriptions display monthly prices at checkout
checkout-service.description: Administrators selecting annual billing saw monthly totals on the checkout page and could not complete their intended purchase. The discrepancy was detected by a pricing validation alert.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed annual plans to the monthly price list. Restoring the correct price list fixed the displayed totals.

checkout-service.title: Card payments fail because the payment gateway certificate expired
checkout-service.description: Users received a payment error when submitting valid card details through checkout-service. Monitoring detected a spike in failed gateway connections.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A certificate used to authenticate checkout-service to the payment gateway had expired. Renewing the certificate and reloading it restored payment processing.

checkout-service.title: Checkout cannot authorize payments during gateway outage
checkout-service.description: Administrators could review their orders but received an error when attempting to pay. The failure affected new subscriptions and paid add-ons. Payment failure alerts identified the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The external payment gateway was unavailable. Checkout recovered when the gateway restored its authorization service.

checkout-service.title: Large workforce orders cause checkout-service to run out of memory
checkout-service.description: Administrators buying licenses for large workforces experienced stalled checkouts and occasional errors. Service restarts and memory alerts revealed the problem.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The order preview loaded a separate pricing object for every employee seat, exhausting available memory. The preview was changed to calculate prices in batches.

checkout-service.title: Discount code validation times out for established tenants
checkout-service.description: Some administrators waited several minutes after applying a discount code, then saw a timeout. Database latency alerts and support reports led responders to the validation query.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The query scanned the full order history when checking previous coupon use. Adding an index and narrowing the query restored normal response times.

checkout-service.title: Saved checkout carts show duplicated add-ons
