checkout-service.description: Some users reopening saved carts saw the same workforce add-on listed multiple times. The inflated totals prevented them from completing purchases. Support identified the issue after comparing affected carts.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A cart migration duplicated add-on rows for a subset of saved carts. The duplicate rows were removed and the migration logic was corrected.

checkout-service.title: Checkout cannot reach the tax calculation service
checkout-service.description: Users saw an error while checkout-service calculated tax for subscription orders. Connection alerts showed that requests could not reach the tax service.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record directed checkout-service to an unavailable address. Correcting the record restored tax calculations.

checkout-service.title: Checkout cannot retrieve subscription prices
checkout-service.description: Administrators saw empty order summaries and could not submit purchases. Error monitoring reported repeated access denials when checkout-service requested prices.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The service account lost permission to read the price catalog during an access policy update. Restoring the read permission resolved the failures.

checkout-service.title: New card payments are rejected after gateway response change
checkout-service.description: Users adding a new payment card received a generic checkout error despite successful card verification. A rise in payment parsing errors alerted the team.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The payment provider changed the format of a field in its verification response. Updating the response parser restored new-card checkouts.

checkout-service.title: Expired reservations prevent users from completing checkout
checkout-service.description: Some administrators returning to checkout were told that their selected license quantity was still reserved, even though the previous session had expired. Support reports and a growing reservation backlog revealed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled job that releases expired reservations had stopped running after a configuration change. Restarting the job and clearing stale reservations allowed affected orders to proceed.

checkout-service.title: Retrying a payment creates duplicate orders
checkout-service.description: Some administrators who retried after a slow payment response found two orders for the same subscription. Duplicate-order monitoring and customer reports detected the problem.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Checkout-service generated a new idempotency key for each retry instead of reusing the original key. The retry logic was fixed and duplicate orders were reconciled.

checkout-service.title: Successful checkouts remain pending after payment
checkout-service.description: Administrators received payment confirmation but their orders remained pending instead of activating the purchased features. A growing backlog of payment events alerted the team.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A consumer for payment confirmation events had stopped processing messages after encountering an unexpected event type. The consumer was fixed and the queued events were replayed.

checkout-service.title: Checkout applies an outdated tax rate
checkout-service.description: Some subscription orders showed an incorrect tax amount despite an updated tax configuration. A reconciliation check comparing checkout totals with current rates detected the discrepancy.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Checkout-service retained tax rates in a cache longer than intended. The cache was refreshed and its expiration setting was corrected.

checkout-service.title: Promotion codes fail when their usage limit is reached concurrently
checkout-service.description: During a busy promotion, some administrators saw a discount applied but received an error when submitting the order. Order failure alerts revealed a cluster of errors for the promotion.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent checkouts could reserve the last available promotion use without an atomic limit check. The reservation logic was changed to enforce the limit atomically.

checkout-service.title: Checkout rejects valid billing addresses with long postal codes
checkout-service.description: Administrators in affected regions could not save valid billing addresses and therefore could not complete checkout. Support reports identified a pattern involving longer postal codes.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Address validation enforced a length limit that was too short for supported regions. The limit was updated and affected users could resubmit their addresses.

checkout-service.title: Checkout sessions expire before users finish payment
checkout-service.description: Administrators were returned to the beginning of checkout after spending a short time entering billing details. Session-expiration metrics and support reports exposed the issue.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A session lifetime setting was interpreted in seconds rather than minutes. Correcting the configured unit restored the intended session duration.

checkout-service.title: Purchase confirmations are not sent after successful checkout
checkout-service.description: Users completed subscription purchases but did not receive confirmation messages. The purchased features were activated normally. A notification delivery alert detected the missing confirmations.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: Checkout-service sent confirmation events with a missing required order field. The event payload was corrected and confirmations were resent for affected orders.

checkout-service.title: Checkout rejects orders after database connections are exhausted
checkout-service.description: Users intermittently saw checkout errors while reviewing and submitting orders. Connection pool alerts showed that checkout-service could not obtain database connections.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: A recent code path failed to release connections after an order validation error. The connection leak was fixed and service instances were restarted to clear the exhausted pools.

checkout-service.title: Seat quantity changes are lost when users return to checkout
checkout-service.description: Administrators who changed their license quantity and returned from the payment step saw the original quantity restored. Support reproduced the issue after receiving reports of unexpected order totals.
checkout-service.resolution_summary: The checkout page restored an older cart snapshot when navigating back from payment. The page was changed to reload the latest saved cart before displaying the order.

order-service.title: Subscription upgrades fail after checkout
order-service.description: Customers attempting to add workforce management modules saw an error after confirming their order. Support reports and an increase in failed order submissions revealed the problem.
order-service.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced an incompatible field in the order validation request. Rolling back the change and correcting the field mapping restored checkout.

order-service.title: Seat increase orders remain in pending status
order-service.description: Administrators could submit orders for additional employee seats, but the orders stayed pending and the seats were not provisioned. An alert on the growing pending-order queue detected the issue.
order-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed order-service at the wrong provisioning queue. Correcting the queue name and replaying pending messages completed the orders.

order-service.title: Order confirmation emails are not sent
order-service.description: Customers completed subscription orders but did not receive confirmation emails. Support reports and a drop in confirmation delivery metrics exposed the failure.
order-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by order-service to connect to the notification service had expired. Renewing the certificate and retrying failed notifications restored delivery.

order-service.title: Card payments fail during subscription checkout
order-service.description: Customers using cards could not complete new subscription orders, although order details were saved. Payment failure alerts and customer reports identified the issue.
order-service.resolution_summary: The external payment provider was unavailable. Once it recovered, order-service retried eligible payment requests and customers could complete checkout.

order-service.title: Order history pages time out for large tenants
order-service.description: Administrators with many historical orders saw timeouts when opening their order history. Database latency alerts showed that order-service queries were taking unusually long.
order-service.resolution_summary: The history query scanned the entire orders table because a filter lacked a suitable index. Adding the index and updating the query restored normal response times.

order-service.title: Duplicate renewal orders appear on customer accounts
order-service.description: Some customers saw two renewal orders for the same subscription period. Billing reconciliation detected the duplicates before both orders were charged.
order-service.resolution_summary: A worker retried renewal requests without an idempotency check after losing acknowledgments. A uniqueness constraint and corrected retry handling prevented new duplicates, and the extra orders were canceled.

order-service.title: Discount codes are rejected for eligible orders
order-service.description: Customers applying valid promotional codes saw a message that the codes were invalid. Support tickets and a rise in rejected discount requests revealed the issue.
order-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect configuration restricted the codes to an unrelated product category. Fixing the eligibility settings allowed valid discounts to be applied.

order-service.title: Order-service cannot resolve the tax calculation service
order-service.description: Customers saw checkout errors when ordering taxable subscription add-ons. Network alerts showed repeated name resolution failures from order-service.
order-service.resolution_summary: A stale DNS record pointed to a retired tax service endpoint. Updating the record and clearing cached entries restored tax calculations.

order-service.title: Canceled orders continue to reserve subscription seats
order-service.description: Administrators canceled seat orders but found that the reserved seats still counted against their account limit. An operations review of reservation totals uncovered the mismatch.
order-service.resolution_summary: The cancellation handler omitted the seat reservation release step. The handler was corrected and affected reservations were released.

order-service.title: Order creation fails when traffic spikes
order-service.description: Customers saw intermittent errors while submitting subscription orders during a surge in checkout traffic. Memory alerts showed order-service instances restarting repeatedly.
order-service.resolution_summary: Order-service retained large request payloads in memory while waiting for payment responses. Reducing payload retention and increasing available capacity stopped the restarts.

order-service.title: Purchase order numbers disappear from saved orders
order-service.description: Administrators entered purchase order numbers at checkout but could not find them on the resulting order records. Support reproduced the problem from customer reports.
order-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration failed to copy the purchase order number into the new storage column. The migration was corrected and values were restored from retained request records where available.

order-service.title: Subscription renewals are not generated
order-service.description: Customers approaching renewal did not see their expected renewal orders. A monitoring check found that the scheduled renewal job had not completed.
order-service.resolution_summary: The job exhausted its execution window while processing a backlog. The batch size and scheduling limits were adjusted, and missed renewal orders were generated.

order-service.title: Administrators cannot view orders after a role update
order-service.description: Authorized account administrators received access denied errors when opening order details. A spike in authorization failures and support reports brought the issue to attention.
order-service.resolution_summary: A permissions update removed the order-read permission from the administrator role. Restoring the permission returned access without changing other roles.

order-service.title: Address validation rejects new subscription orders
order-service.description: Customers with valid billing addresses could not submit orders because address validation failed. Checkout error monitoring showed failures concentrated at the address verification step.
order-service.resolution_summary: The address verification provider changed a response field used by order-service. Updating the response parser restored validation.

order-service.title: Order totals show an incorrect tax amount
order-service.description: Some customers saw tax calculated on the full price even when a discount was applied. Billing reconciliation identified discrepancies between order totals and expected charges.
order-service.resolution_summary: The tax calculation used the subtotal before discount rather than the discounted taxable amount. The calculation was corrected and affected orders were adjusted.

order-service.title: Completed orders do not activate purchased add-ons
order-service.description: Customers were charged for add-ons, but the features did not become available. An alert detected completed orders with no corresponding activation acknowledgment.
order-service.resolution_summary: A message consumer stopped processing activation events after encountering a malformed message. The message was isolated, the consumer was restarted, and the remaining events were replayed.

order-service.title: Order search returns records from the wrong account
order-service.description: Administrators searching order history saw results that did not belong to their account. A customer report led to an immediate review of search access.
order-service.resolution_summary: A search query omitted the account filter for a specific combination of filters. The query was fixed and search results were restricted to the requesting account.

order-service.title: Refund requests remain stuck after approval
order-service.description: Approved refunds continued to show as processing and customers did not receive their money. An alert on aging refund orders detected the backlog.
order-service.resolution_summary: A network policy blocked order-service from reaching the payment provider's refund endpoint. Restoring the required connection allowed queued refunds to be processed.

order-service.title: Orders fail when billing currency is changed
order-service.description: Customers who changed their account billing currency could not place new add-on orders. Support reproduced the errors and traced them to mismatched currency values in order records.
order-service.resolution_summary: Order-service cached the previous currency after an account update. Invalidating the cache on currency changes and refreshing affected entries resolved the failures.

order-service.title: Order exports contain missing line items
order-service.description: Administrators downloading order exports found that some multi-item orders showed only their first line item. A support investigation compared the exports with stored order details.
order-service.resolution_summary: The export formatter incorrectly collapsed line items with the same order number. Correcting the grouping logic restored complete exports.

inventory-service.title: New equipment assignments were not saved
inventory-service.description: Managers saw a success message after assigning laptops to employees, but the assignments disappeared on refresh. This left devices available for duplicate assignment. Support detected the issue after several managers reported missing records.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the assignment request format without updating the write handler. The deploy was rolled back and the handler was updated.

inventory-service.title: Stock counts showed zero for some storage locations
inventory-service.description: Inventory pages showed zero available items at several locations even though stock was present. Managers could not reliably plan equipment requests. A reconciliation alert detected the mismatch between location and item totals.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change excluded several location codes from inventory queries. The missing codes were restored and the counts were refreshed.

inventory-service.title: Barcode scans failed to retrieve equipment records
inventory-service.description: Employees scanning asset barcodes received a connection error instead of item details. Equipment checkouts had to be recorded manually. The failure was detected by a synthetic barcode lookup check.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the barcode lookup endpoint had expired. The certificate was renewed and automatic renewal monitoring was added.

inventory-service.title: Equipment availability remained stale after check-in
inventory-service.description: Returned equipment continued to appear unavailable for assignment. Managers delayed onboarding allocations because they could not see the returned stock. An alert showed a growing backlog of inventory update messages.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The message broker used to publish check-in events was unavailable. Once it recovered, the backlog was replayed and availability counts were rebuilt.

inventory-service.title: Inventory imports stopped partway through large files
inventory-service.description: Large equipment imports failed after processing only part of the file. Some items appeared in the catalog while the rest had to be retried. The issue was detected through import failure alerts and support reports.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The import worker loaded entire files into memory and exhausted its memory limit. The worker was changed to process rows in batches.

inventory-service.title: Inventory search timed out for large catalogs
inventory-service.description: Searches across large equipment catalogs timed out or returned after a long delay. Managers could not quickly find items to assign or replenish. Database latency alerts identified the affected search query.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A search filter caused a full scan of the asset table. An index was added and the query was revised to use it.

inventory-service.title: Some equipment records displayed the wrong serial number
inventory-service.description: A subset of asset records showed serial numbers belonging to other items. Auditors could not reliably match physical equipment to inventory records. The discrepancy was found during a stock reconciliation.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A faulty bulk update matched rows by an incomplete key and overwrote serial numbers. The affected values were restored from a verified backup and the update logic was corrected.

inventory-service.title: Inventory service could not resolve the stock ledger host
inventory-service.description: Inventory pages intermittently failed to load current stock levels. Users could view item names but could not confirm availability. Connection error alerts showed repeated hostname resolution failures.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record pointed the service to an unavailable ledger host. The record was corrected and cached entries were allowed to refresh.

inventory-service.title: Managers could not transfer stock between locations
inventory-service.description: Authorized managers received a permission error when moving equipment between storage locations. Transfer records were not created, leaving location counts unchanged. Support detected the issue after reports from multiple managers.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A role policy change removed the permission required to create transfer records. The permission was restored and a role access test was added.

inventory-service.title: Supplier deliveries stopped updating inventory quantities
inventory-service.description: Received orders remained pending in inventory after suppliers marked them delivered. Available quantities were understated until staff entered receipts manually. A mismatch alert flagged deliveries without corresponding stock receipts.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The supplier API changed the delivery status value expected by the inventory integration. The integration was updated to accept the new value and missed receipts were replayed.

inventory-service.title: Low-stock alerts were not generated
inventory-service.description: Managers did not receive alerts when essential equipment fell below its reorder threshold. Some locations ran out before replenishment orders were placed. The missing alerts were discovered during a review of low-stock items.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled stock threshold job had stopped running after its execution token was revoked. The job credentials were renewed and monitoring was added for missed runs.

inventory-service.title: Concurrent checkouts assigned the same device twice
inventory-service.description: Two managers were able to check out the same device to different employees. Staff had to resolve conflicting assignment records before issuing the equipment. The problem was detected by a duplicate active assignment check.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The checkout flow checked availability before acquiring a database lock. An atomic availability update and a uniqueness constraint prevented concurrent assignments.

inventory-service.title: Returned equipment stayed reserved after request cancellation
inventory-service.description: Canceled equipment requests continued to hold reserved stock. Available quantities appeared lower than the physical stock on hand. The issue was detected when a location reported unused devices that could not be reassigned.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The cancellation handler did not release reservations for partially fulfilled requests. The handler was fixed and the affected reservations were cleared.

inventory-service.title: Inventory exports omitted custom equipment categories
inventory-service.description: Downloaded inventory reports excluded items in tenant-defined categories. Managers received incomplete totals for equipment audits. The discrepancy was discovered when export totals were compared with the inventory page.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The export query filtered categories using a fixed list. It was updated to include custom categories, and affected reports were regenerated.

inventory-service.title: Equipment images failed to upload
inventory-service.description: Users received an error when adding photos to equipment records. Existing records remained usable, but new items lacked images needed for identification. Upload failure alerts brought the issue to the support team's attention.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The inventory service had lost write access to its image storage container. Storage permissions were restored and an upload check was added.

inventory-service.title: Inventory pages displayed outdated quantities after adjustments
inventory-service.description: Stock adjustments saved successfully, but inventory pages continued to show the previous quantities. Managers repeated some adjustments because they believed the first attempt had failed. Support identified the issue from reports of inconsistent stock counts.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: The adjustment handler failed to invalidate cached location totals. Cache invalidation was added and the duplicate adjustments were reviewed.

inventory-service.title: Equipment requests were rejected despite available stock
inventory-service.description: Employees received an out-of-stock message when requesting certain items that were available. Managers could not fulfill the affected requests through the normal workflow. The issue was detected by comparing rejected requests with stock records.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A unit conversion rounded small available quantities down to zero. The conversion was corrected and affected requests were reopened.

inventory-service.title: Asset history showed events in the wrong order
inventory-service.description: Some equipment history pages showed returns before the corresponding checkouts. This made it difficult to trace who held a device. An audit review detected the inconsistent event order.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: Events from one integration were stored without their time zone offset. Timestamp parsing was corrected and affected history entries were reordered.

inventory-service.title: Inventory requests failed during peak onboarding activity
inventory-service.description: Managers saw intermittent errors while searching for and assigning equipment. Requests often succeeded on retry, but onboarding work was delayed. Service metrics showed that the database connection pool was exhausted.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A request path failed to release database connections after an error. The connection handling was fixed and pool usage monitoring was tightened.

inventory-service.title: Archived items reappeared in equipment request lists
inventory-service.description: Employees could see and request discontinued equipment that managers had archived. Requests for those items required manual cancellation. The issue was detected when support received reports of unavailable devices appearing in the catalog.
inventory-service.resolution_summary: A catalog synchronization job overwrote the archived flag with an older supplier value. The sync was changed to preserve local archive status and affected items were archived again.

shipping-service.title: Onboarding kit orders fail at shipment creation
shipping-service.description: Administrators saw an error when requesting shipments for new employees. The failure prevented onboarding kits from entering the dispatch queue. Support noticed a rise in failed shipment requests.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced a required field that older order requests did not include. The deploy was rolled back, and failed requests were retried.

shipping-service.title: Shipping labels show the wrong return address
shipping-service.description: Labels for employee equipment shipments displayed an outdated return address. Administrators reported that undeliverable packages could be sent to the wrong location. The issue was detected during a label review.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change selected the wrong return address template. The correct template was restored and affected labels were regenerated.

shipping-service.title: Carrier label requests fail after certificate expiration
shipping-service.description: Administrators could not generate carrier labels for employee equipment orders. Pending shipments accumulated, and monitoring detected repeated secure connection failures.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate shipping-service to the carrier had expired. The certificate was renewed and pending label requests were replayed.

shipping-service.title: Shipment tracking updates stop appearing
shipping-service.description: Employees saw stale tracking statuses for their onboarding kits. Shipping-service monitoring detected that tracking responses were no longer arriving from the carrier.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The carrier's tracking API was unavailable. Shipping-service resumed polling after the carrier recovered and refreshed the affected tracking records.

shipping-service.title: Bulk equipment shipments remain queued
shipping-service.description: Large batches of employee equipment orders stayed in the shipping queue. Administrators could not dispatch the orders, and queue age alerts detected the backlog.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping workers exhausted available memory while loading entire batches at once. Batch processing was changed to load smaller chunks, and the backlog was processed.

shipping-service.title: Shipment history takes too long to load
shipping-service.description: Administrators experienced long waits or timeouts when viewing shipment history for large workforces. The issue was detected by latency alerts and support reports.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A shipment history query scanned the tracking events table without a suitable index. An index was added and the query was updated to limit the rows read.

shipping-service.title: Some shipments disappear from the administrator dashboard
shipping-service.description: Administrators could not find certain employee equipment shipments even though the packages had been dispatched. A reconciliation report detected a mismatch between shipment records and dashboard results.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A failed data migration left some shipment records with an invalid status value. The affected records were repaired and the migration validation was corrected.

shipping-service.title: Address validation fails for all new shipment requests
shipping-service.description: Administrators received address validation errors when scheduling employee shipments. The requests could not proceed, and monitoring showed connection failures to the validation provider.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration error directed shipping-service to an unreachable address. The DNS record was corrected and queued validation requests were retried.

shipping-service.title: Warehouse staff cannot download packing slips
shipping-service.description: Warehouse staff saw access errors when downloading packing slips for onboarding kits. Orders could not be packed, and the problem was reported through support.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed shipping-service access to the document store. The required access was restored and the failed downloads succeeded.

shipping-service.title: Carrier rejects international shipment requests
shipping-service.description: Administrators could create domestic shipments but international requests failed during label generation. Support identified the pattern after reports from multiple customers.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The carrier changed a required customs field in its API. Shipping-service was updated to send the new field, and affected requests were resubmitted.

shipping-service.title: Delivered shipments remain marked as in transit
shipping-service.description: Employees continued to see in-transit statuses after their packages were delivered. A reconciliation check detected delivered carrier events that had not been applied.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled tracking reconciliation job stopped after encountering a malformed event. The job was fixed to isolate invalid events and rerun for the missed records.

shipping-service.title: Employees receive duplicate shipment notifications
shipping-service.description: Some employees received multiple dispatch notifications for the same onboarding kit. Support noticed the issue after customers reported repeated messages.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping-service retried notification requests without an idempotency check. A deduplication key was added and duplicate pending notifications were removed.

shipping-service.title: Shipment cancellations do not reach the carrier
shipping-service.description: Administrators saw canceled orders in the dashboard, but some packages were still dispatched. The discrepancy was detected when canceled orders appeared in a carrier pickup report.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A message consumer acknowledged cancellation events before sending them to the carrier, allowing failures to be lost. Acknowledgment was moved after successful processing, and unresolved cancellations were reviewed.

shipping-service.title: Postal codes lose leading zeros on shipping labels
shipping-service.description: Some labels showed incomplete destination postal codes, causing delivery delays. The issue was found when administrators compared generated labels with employee address records.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping-service converted postal codes to numbers while building label requests. Postal codes were changed to remain text, and affected labels were regenerated.

shipping-service.title: Shipping rate estimates fail for large orders
shipping-service.description: Administrators could not obtain shipping estimates for large equipment orders. Monitoring detected repeated rate calculation errors for orders with many packages.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping-service exceeded the carrier's package limit for a single rate request. Requests were split into supported sizes and the results were combined.

shipping-service.title: Employee shipment addresses are not updated after edits
shipping-service.description: Administrators changed employee delivery addresses, but newly created shipments used previous values. The issue was detected when packing staff noticed mismatches between order details and labels.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: An address cache was not invalidated when employee records changed. Cache invalidation was added, and unshipped orders with stale addresses were corrected.

shipping-service.title: Return labels are unavailable for employee equipment
shipping-service.description: Administrators could not generate return labels for departing employees. Support detected repeated failures when customers attempted to arrange equipment returns.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A routing rule sent return-label requests to the outbound-only carrier endpoint. The rule was corrected and affected return labels were generated.

shipping-service.title: Shipment tracking links open another employee's order
shipping-service.description: Some employees opening tracking links saw an order that was not theirs. A customer reported the mismatch, and access to the affected links was disabled while it was investigated.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A link-generation defect reused a shipment token across multiple orders. Token generation was fixed, affected links were revoked, and new links were issued.

shipping-service.title: Package weights are incorrect on generated labels
shipping-service.description: Labels for some employee equipment shipments showed weights much higher than expected. Warehouse staff detected the issue when carrier pickup charges did not match the order estimates.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: A unit conversion was applied twice when shipment weights were sent to the carrier. The duplicate conversion was removed and unused labels were replaced.

shipping-service.title: Shipment creation fails during carrier connection spikes
shipping-service.description: Administrators intermittently received errors when creating employee shipments. Monitoring showed that failures increased when many label requests arrived together.
shipping-service.resolution_summary: Shipping-service exhausted its outbound connection pool because carrier responses were not always closed. Response cleanup was fixed and the pool was tuned for peak request volume.

notification-service.title: Payroll approval emails showed blank action buttons
notification-service.description: Managers received payroll approval emails with blank buttons and could not open the approval screen from the message. Support reports and a drop in notification link clicks exposed the problem.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A deployment changed the button field name without updating the email template. The template was corrected and affected notifications were resent.

notification-service.title: Shift reminder text messages stopped sending
notification-service.description: Employees did not receive text reminders before their shifts. The notification delivery dashboard showed that text messages were being rejected before reaching the provider.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change disabled the text messaging channel. Restoring the channel configuration allowed queued reminders to be sent.

notification-service.title: Mobile push notifications failed certificate validation
notification-service.description: Employees stopped receiving push alerts for new schedule assignments. Delivery error alerts showed repeated certificate validation failures.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to connect to the push gateway had expired. Replacing it and restarting the gateway connections restored delivery.

notification-service.title: Email notifications delayed during provider outage
notification-service.description: Payslip and leave request emails remained queued instead of arriving promptly. The queue age alert and provider status checks showed that the email provider was unavailable.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The external email provider experienced an outage. The queue drained after the provider recovered, and delivery resumed.

notification-service.title: Bulk schedule updates caused notification workers to restart
notification-service.description: Large schedule changes produced delayed or missing employee notifications. Worker restart alerts and memory usage graphs identified the failure during a bulk update.
notification-service.resolution_summary: Workers loaded all recipients for a bulk notification into memory at once. Processing recipients in bounded batches stopped the memory exhaustion.

notification-service.title: Notification history pages loaded slowly for large tenants
notification-service.description: Administrators waited unusually long to view notification delivery history for large workforces. Slow request alerts and database query logs revealed the issue.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The history query scanned delivery records without a suitable index. Adding an index for tenant and creation time restored normal response times.

notification-service.title: Corrupted preference records blocked leave request alerts
notification-service.description: Some employees did not receive leave request updates despite having notifications enabled. Support reports led engineers to delivery errors for unreadable preference records.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A faulty migration wrote invalid values into a subset of preference records. The records were repaired and the migration was corrected before affected alerts were retried.

notification-service.title: Notification workers could not resolve the text message gateway
notification-service.description: Text notifications for shift changes remained queued and were not delivered. Connection error alerts showed that workers could not resolve the gateway hostname.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the resolver entry needed by the workers. Restoring the entry allowed connections and queued messages resumed delivery.

notification-service.title: Payslip emails were sent without their attachments
notification-service.description: Employees received payslip notifications without the expected document attached. Support reports and attachment retrieval errors revealed the issue.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The notification worker lost permission to read payslip files from document storage. Restoring the read permission fixed new deliveries, and affected messages were resent.

notification-service.title: Push gateway rejected schedule alerts after API field change
notification-service.description: Employees stopped receiving push notifications for schedule changes. Delivery logs showed that the push gateway was rejecting requests with an invalid payload.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The gateway changed a required payload field. Updating the notification-service request format restored push delivery.

notification-service.title: Daily leave summary emails were not generated
notification-service.description: Managers did not receive their daily summaries of pending leave requests. A missing job completion alert identified the failure before support confirmed the impact.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The summary scheduler failed while loading its recipient list and did not retry. Fixing the list query and rerunning the job restored the summaries.

notification-service.title: One malformed event blocked notifications behind it
notification-service.description: Shift and leave notifications accumulated in a queue and arrived late. Queue age alerts showed that a worker was repeatedly processing the same event.
notification-service.resolution_summary: An event with a missing required field caused the consumer to retry indefinitely. The event was moved to a dead-letter queue and validation was added to prevent future blockage.

notification-service.title: Delivery status stayed pending after emails were received
notification-service.description: Administrators saw email notifications marked as pending even though recipients had received them. A mismatch between provider delivery counts and notification-service status reports exposed the issue.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The delivery webhook verifier used an outdated signing certificate and rejected provider callbacks. Updating the verifier restored status updates, and missed callbacks were reconciled.

notification-service.title: Shift reminders arrived an hour late after clock changes
notification-service.description: Some employees received shift reminders an hour later than their configured reminder time. Support reports from affected locations and a comparison with scheduled shifts revealed the pattern.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The scheduler used a fixed time offset instead of the employee's time zone rules. Calculating reminder times with the correct time zone restored expected delivery.

notification-service.title: Some payroll notifications were incorrectly suppressed as duplicates
notification-service.description: Employees who had multiple payroll events received only one of their expected notifications. Support reports and suppressed-message logs showed that distinct events shared a deduplication key.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The key omitted the payroll event identifier. Including that identifier stopped unrelated notifications from being suppressed, and missed messages were replayed.

notification-service.title: Disabled text reminders continued after employees opted out
notification-service.description: Some employees received shift reminder texts after turning off text notifications. Support reports showed that the delivery decisions did not match saved preferences.
notification-service.resolution_summary: Notification workers retained cached preferences after changes were saved. Invalidating the cache on preference updates stopped the unwanted messages.

notification-service.title: Notification requests were rejected after a rate limit change
notification-service.description: A tenant's schedule update produced fewer notifications than expected. Request rejection metrics showed that notification-service was applying a lower limit than intended.
notification-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change applied a per-user limit to all requests from the tenant. Correcting the limit scope allowed rejected notifications to be retried.

notification-service.title: Email delivery stopped after outbound network rules changed
notification-service.description: Leave approval and payroll emails remained in the delivery queue. Connection timeout alerts began immediately after a network rule update.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The updated firewall rules blocked outbound connections to the email relay. Restoring the required outbound rule allowed the queue to drain.

notification-service.title: Notification logs filled worker storage and stopped delivery
notification-service.description: New notifications were accepted but delivery slowed and then stopped. Disk usage alerts showed that notification workers had run out of local storage.
notification-service.resolution_summary: Verbose delivery logs were not being rotated and filled the worker disks. Removing old logs and restoring log rotation returned workers to service.

notification-service.title: Employee notifications were sent in the wrong language
notification-service.description: Some employees received leave and schedule emails in a language different from their saved preference. Support reports and template selection logs exposed the mismatch.
notification-service.resolution_summary: The locale lookup used the tenant default instead of the employee preference. Correcting the lookup restored the intended language for subsequent messages.

email-service.title: Payslip notification emails fail to render
email-service.description: Employees did not receive notifications when new payslips were available, although payroll processing completed. An increase in template rendering errors alerted the email-service team.
email-service.resolution_summary: A deploy renamed a template variable without updating the payslip template. The template was corrected and failed notifications were replayed.

email-service.title: Onboarding invitations blocked by suppression rule
email-service.description: New hires did not receive onboarding invitations because email-service rejected their messages before delivery. Support noticed the issue after several customers reported missing invitations.
email-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change mistakenly applied the marketing opt-out list to onboarding invitations. The rule was corrected and affected invitations were resent.

email-service.title: Outbound email connections fail after certificate expires
email-service.description: Email-service could not establish encrypted connections to its delivery gateway, leaving notifications queued. Connection failure alerts identified the expired certificate.
email-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used by email-service had expired because its renewal was missed. The certificate was replaced and queued messages were delivered.

email-service.title: Leave approval notifications delayed by delivery provider outage
email-service.description: Managers received leave approval requests hours after employees submitted them. Queue age alerts showed that email-service could not reach its delivery provider.
email-service.resolution_summary: The delivery provider experienced an outage and rejected outbound connections. Email-service resumed delivery when the provider recovered and drained the backlog.

email-service.title: Large payroll attachments exhaust email-service memory
email-service.description: Payroll administrators saw export emails fail when they included large attachments. Memory alerts and repeated worker restarts revealed the problem.
email-service.resolution_summary: Workers loaded entire attachments into memory before encoding them. Streaming the attachments prevented memory exhaustion, and failed messages were retried.

email-service.title: Email history searches time out for large tenants
email-service.description: Administrators could not load the email delivery history for tenants with many notifications. Slow query monitoring detected repeated timeouts in email-service.
email-service.resolution_summary: The history query scanned the delivery log without a suitable index. Adding an index and updating the query restored normal response times.

email-service.title: Corrupted queue records prevent shift reminders from sending
email-service.description: Some employees did not receive upcoming shift reminders even though their schedules were correct. Queue processing alerts showed repeated failures on a small group of messages.
email-service.resolution_summary: A serialization defect wrote malformed reminder records to the queue. The records were repaired and the serializer was fixed before processing resumed.

email-service.title: DNS failures interrupt outbound email delivery
email-service.description: Notification emails remained queued because email-service could not resolve the delivery gateway hostname. DNS error alerts and queue growth exposed the interruption.
email-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS configuration returned no usable address for the gateway. Restoring the correct records allowed the queued messages to be sent.

email-service.title: Email-service cannot read newly uploaded templates
email-service.description: Administrators could save custom notification templates, but emails using those templates failed to send. Template loading errors appeared in email-service logs.
email-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the service account's read access to template storage. Read access was restored and failed messages were replayed.

email-service.title: Provider API change rejects employee welcome emails
email-service.description: New employees did not receive welcome emails after account creation. Delivery error monitoring showed that the provider was rejecting requests from email-service.
email-service.resolution_summary: The provider changed a required field in its send API. Email-service was updated to use the new field and retried the rejected messages.

email-service.title: Daily timesheet reminder job fails to start
email-service.description: Employees did not receive reminders to complete outstanding timesheets. A missing-job alert detected that email-service had not generated the expected reminder batch.
email-service.resolution_summary: A scheduler configuration error disabled the reminder job. The schedule was restored and the missed batch was generated.

email-service.title: Queue consumer stalls on a malformed email request
email-service.description: Several types of employee notifications stopped sending while new requests continued to accumulate. Queue depth alerts showed that one consumer partition had stopped advancing.
email-service.resolution_summary: A malformed request caused the consumer to retry indefinitely without moving to the next message. The request was isolated and retry handling was changed to prevent the stall.

email-service.title: Email authentication failures send notifications to spam
email-service.description: Some employees found payroll and leave notifications in their spam folders. Delivery monitoring showed a rise in authentication failures reported by recipient mail servers.
email-service.resolution_summary: A signing key rotation left email-service using a key that did not match the published domain record. The signing configuration was corrected and authentication checks recovered.

email-service.title: Notification delivery slows after provider rate limit is exceeded
email-service.description: Employees received shift change emails much later than the corresponding schedule updates. Delivery latency alerts showed that email-service was repeatedly receiving rate limit responses.
email-service.resolution_summary: A bulk notification exceeded the provider's allowed sending rate. Rate-aware batching was enabled and the remaining messages were sent gradually.

email-service.title: Bounce status updates stop appearing in email history
email-service.description: Administrators saw bounced notifications marked as sent and could not identify recipients needing updated contact details. A drop in bounce event processing triggered an alert.
email-service.resolution_summary: A webhook routing change sent provider bounce events to an inactive handler. The route was corrected and available events were replayed.

email-service.title: Employees receive duplicate leave decision emails
email-service.description: Some employees received the same leave approval or rejection email multiple times. Support reports and delivery log checks revealed repeated sends for individual decisions.
email-service.resolution_summary: A retry path created a new delivery request after a timeout even when the original request had succeeded. A stable deduplication key was added to prevent repeat sends.

email-service.title: Localized onboarding emails contain the wrong language
email-service.description: Some new hires received onboarding invitations in a different language from the one selected by their employer. Customer reports led the team to inspect email-service's language selection.
email-service.resolution_summary: A locale mapping error matched regional language codes to the wrong templates. The mapping was corrected and affected invitations were resent.

email-service.title: Calendar attachments cannot be opened from shift emails
email-service.description: Employees could read shift assignment emails but could not import their attached calendar invitations. Support reproduced the issue using affected messages.
email-service.resolution_summary: Email-service generated calendar attachments with an invalid line ending format. The attachment encoder was corrected and replacement invitations were sent.

email-service.title: Notification links expire immediately after delivery
email-service.description: Employees could not open secure document links in notification emails, even when they clicked promptly. Support reports and link validation errors identified the failure.
email-service.resolution_summary: A clock synchronization failure caused email-service to issue links with expiry times in the past. The clock was corrected and affected notifications were reissued.

email-service.title: Custom sender names disappear from tenant notifications
email-service.description: Employees received automated emails with a generic sender name instead of their employer's configured name. Administrators reported the change after checking recent notifications.
email-service.resolution_summary: A cache refresh defect replaced tenant sender settings with default values. The refresh logic was fixed and the cached settings were rebuilt.

search-service.title: Employee search returned no results after a deployment
search-service.description: Users searching the employee directory saw empty result lists even when matching employees existed. Support reports and a drop in successful searches revealed the problem.
search-service.resolution_summary: A deployment changed the query field name without updating the index mapping. Rolling back the change restored results.

search-service.title: New hires were missing from directory search
search-service.description: Recently added employees did not appear in search, although their profiles were available directly. A freshness alert detected a growing delay between profile creation and indexing.
search-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed the indexer to the wrong event subscription. Correcting the subscription allowed pending updates to be indexed.

search-service.title: Search requests failed after a certificate expired
search-service.description: Users received errors when searching for employees or documents. Connection failure alerts showed that search-service could not reach its index cluster.
search-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used for the index connection had expired. Replacing it restored secure connections and search traffic.

search-service.title: Document search failed during an object storage outage
search-service.description: Users could not find newly uploaded policy documents, while older indexed documents remained searchable. An indexing alert and support reports identified the issue.
search-service.resolution_summary: An object storage outage prevented search-service from reading document content for indexing. The service recovered after storage returned and the failed indexing tasks were retried.

search-service.title: Broad directory searches timed out under heavy load
search-service.description: Users searching common employee names saw long waits followed by timeouts. Latency alerts showed that search-service had exhausted its worker capacity during a traffic spike.
search-service.resolution_summary: The available worker pool could not handle the volume of concurrent broad queries. Increasing capacity and limiting concurrent expensive queries restored response times.

search-service.title: Search workers restarted while indexing large attachments
search-service.description: Users intermittently received search errors while large employee documents were being indexed. Restart alerts showed repeated memory exhaustion in search-service workers.
search-service.resolution_summary: The attachment parser loaded entire large files into memory at once. A size limit and streaming parser stopped the worker restarts.

search-service.title: Filtering employees by department caused search timeouts
search-service.description: Directory searches with a department filter took much longer than unfiltered searches and often timed out. Query latency monitoring identified the affected filter.
search-service.resolution_summary: A missing database index made the department lookup scan a large membership table. Adding the index reduced lookup time and restored filtered searches.

search-service.title: Some employee profiles appeared twice in search results
search-service.description: Users saw duplicate entries for a subset of employees in directory search. The problem was detected when support compared search results with the source employee records.
search-service.resolution_summary: A failed migration left duplicate documents under different index keys. Removing the duplicates and rebuilding the affected index restored one result per employee.

search-service.title: Search-service could not resolve its index endpoint
search-service.description: Users received search errors across the directory and document search pages. Connection alerts showed that search-service could not resolve the index cluster hostname.
search-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record pointed queries to a nonexistent hostname. Restoring the correct record allowed search-service to reconnect.

search-service.title: Managers could not find employees in their teams
search-service.description: Managers searching for their direct and indirect reports saw incomplete results. Support reports revealed that the missing employees could still be found by administrators.
search-service.resolution_summary: A permission rule incorrectly excluded indirect reports from manager searches. Correcting the rule and refreshing cached permissions restored the expected results.

search-service.title: Employee search indexing stopped after an HR API response change
search-service.description: Updates to employee names and job titles stopped appearing in search results. An indexing error alert showed repeated failures when processing profile responses.
search-service.resolution_summary: A third-party HR API changed a field from a string to an object. Updating the response parser and replaying failed updates restored index freshness.

search-service.title: Deleted employee profiles remained visible in search
search-service.description: Users could still find some removed employee profiles in directory results, although opening them failed. A reconciliation check detected the mismatch between source records and the search index.
search-service.resolution_summary: A scheduled cleanup job had stopped processing deletion events after its checkpoint became invalid. Resetting the checkpoint and replaying deletions removed the stale results.

search-service.title: Search results exposed documents from another tenant
search-service.description: Some users saw document titles belonging to a different tenant in search results. A customer report prompted a review of search logs and access controls.
search-service.resolution_summary: A query path omitted the tenant filter when combining text and category filters. Restoring the filter and testing tenant isolation stopped the cross-tenant results.

search-service.title: Search suggestions returned outdated employee names
search-service.description: The autocomplete menu suggested former names even after employee profiles had been updated. Support reproduced the mismatch between suggestions and full search results.
search-service.resolution_summary: The suggestion cache was not invalidated when name updates were indexed. Fixing cache invalidation and clearing stale entries refreshed the suggestions.

search-service.title: Search failed for names containing accented characters
search-service.description: Users searching for employees by names with accents received no matches despite the profiles being present. Support identified the pattern across several reported searches.
search-service.resolution_summary: The query analyzer normalized accented characters differently from the index analyzer. Aligning the analyzers and rebuilding the affected index restored matches.

search-service.title: Search results stopped after the first page
search-service.description: Users could see initial search results but received an error when loading the next page. An increase in pagination errors revealed the issue.
search-service.resolution_summary: A new pagination token format was incompatible with tokens issued by existing search workers. Updating token handling to accept both formats restored paging.

search-service.title: Payroll document searches returned irrelevant results
search-service.description: Users searching payroll documents saw unrelated documents ranked above exact matches. Support reports and relevance checks showed a sudden drop in result quality.
search-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change assigned excessive weight to common document terms. Restoring the previous ranking weights returned exact matches to the top.

search-service.title: Search updates accumulated in the indexing queue
search-service.description: Employee profile changes took much longer than usual to appear in search. Queue depth and indexing delay alerts detected the backlog.
search-service.resolution_summary: A malformed event caused the queue consumer to retry the same message indefinitely. Moving the invalid event aside and fixing validation allowed the backlog to drain.

search-service.title: Search requests failed intermittently between service components
search-service.description: Users experienced sporadic search errors and retries, while other requests succeeded. Network monitoring showed packet loss between search-service and its index cluster.
search-service.resolution_summary: A faulty network route dropped part of the traffic to the index cluster. Replacing the route restored stable connections.

search-service.title: Shift searches omitted records with overnight start times
search-service.description: Users searching for overnight shifts saw incomplete results even though the shifts appeared in schedules. Support compared search results with the underlying shift records.
search-service.resolution_summary: The indexing process assigned overnight shifts to the wrong calendar day when converting time zones. Correcting the conversion and reindexing affected shifts restored the missing results.

reporting-service.title: Payroll exports timed out for large tenants
reporting-service.description: Users with large payroll histories saw exports fail before the download was ready. The reporting-service team detected the issue through a rise in export timeout alerts and support reports.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A recent query change caused payroll exports to scan the full earnings table. Adding the missing index and reverting the query change restored normal export times.

reporting-service.title: Headcount dashboards showed duplicate employees
reporting-service.description: Managers saw inflated headcount totals in reporting-service dashboards. Support reports prompted a comparison with employee directory records.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A deployment joined employees to multiple active assignment records without deduplicating them. The join was corrected and the affected dashboard cache was rebuilt.

reporting-service.title: Scheduled attendance reports stopped arriving
reporting-service.description: Users did not receive their scheduled attendance report downloads. The reporting-service team noticed a growing queue of overdue report jobs.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A scheduler configuration change disabled the worker responsible for recurring reports. Restoring the worker setting and replaying the queued jobs resumed delivery.

reporting-service.title: Report downloads failed after the signing certificate expired
reporting-service.description: Users could generate reports but received an error when downloading the files. Reporting-service alerts showed failures when requests reached the file storage gateway.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate reporting-service to the storage gateway had expired. Renewing the certificate and restarting the affected connections restored downloads.

reporting-service.title: Benefits enrollment reports failed when the enrollment service was unavailable
reporting-service.description: Users saw errors when opening benefits enrollment reports. Reporting-service dependency alerts and support reports identified the failures.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The enrollment service was unavailable, so reporting-service could not retrieve current enrollment data. The dependency was restored and failed report requests succeeded on retry.

reporting-service.title: Large overtime reports caused reporting workers to restart
reporting-service.description: Users saw overtime reports fail partway through generation, especially for organizations with many time entries. Reporting-service monitoring showed repeated worker restarts and high memory use.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The report generator loaded all matching time entries into memory at once. Changing it to process entries in batches stopped the restarts.

reporting-service.title: Labor cost reports were delayed by a database connection limit
reporting-service.description: Users waited unusually long for labor cost reports, and some requests failed. Reporting-service metrics showed requests waiting for database connections.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A connection pool limit was too low for the volume of concurrent reports. The pool was resized and report concurrency was capped to protect the database.

reporting-service.title: Custom report filters returned results from the wrong department
reporting-service.description: Users who selected one department sometimes saw rows belonging to another department in custom reports. A customer report led the reporting-service team to reproduce the incorrect filter behavior.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A filter parser treated department codes as partial matches rather than exact values. The parser was corrected and affected cached results were cleared.

reporting-service.title: Managers could not access reports for their direct teams
reporting-service.description: Managers received access denied errors when opening reports they normally used. Reporting-service authorization logs showed an increase in rejected requests.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A role mapping change omitted the permission needed to read team-level report data. Restoring the permission mapping resolved access for affected managers.

reporting-service.title: CSV exports opened with columns shifted
reporting-service.description: Users found that some employee names and notes appeared under the wrong columns in downloaded CSV reports. Support reproduced the issue using records containing commas and quotation marks.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The reporting-service CSV writer did not escape special characters correctly. Updating the writer to quote those fields fixed newly generated exports.

reporting-service.title: Turnover reports showed stale employee status data
reporting-service.description: Users saw former employees counted as active in turnover reports. A reconciliation check between reporting-service and the employee directory detected the mismatch.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled employee status import had stopped after encountering an unexpected empty field. The import was made tolerant of the field and the missed updates were replayed.

reporting-service.title: Report generation failed after a DNS change
reporting-service.description: Users saw intermittent errors when generating reports that included employee profile data. Reporting-service logs showed that requests could not resolve the profile service name.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change pointed the service name at an invalid resolver. Restoring the resolver configuration and clearing cached lookups fixed report generation.

reporting-service.title: Tax summary reports failed after a provider response changed
reporting-service.description: Users could not generate tax summary reports that included filing status. Reporting-service errors began when the external tax provider returned a different response format.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The provider renamed a response field that reporting-service expected to be present. The integration was updated to accept the new field and failed reports were regenerated.

reporting-service.title: Time-off balances appeared negative in summary reports
reporting-service.description: Users saw negative time-off balances for employees whose balances were positive in the leave system. A customer comparison exposed the discrepancy in reporting-service summaries.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A transformation subtracted approved leave twice when rebuilding the reporting dataset. The calculation was corrected and the affected summaries were rebuilt.

reporting-service.title: Report filters reset when users changed pages
reporting-service.description: Users browsing a multi-page report saw unfiltered rows after moving beyond the first page. Support reproduced the problem in reporting-service with several filter combinations.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A frontend deployment omitted filter parameters from pagination requests. Restoring those parameters kept the selected filters across pages.

reporting-service.title: Shift coverage reports missed recently published schedules
reporting-service.description: Managers saw gaps in shift coverage reports even though the schedules had been published. A freshness alert showed that reporting-service was falling behind on schedule updates.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A malformed schedule event blocked its processing partition. The event was repaired and the consumer was changed to isolate invalid events while continuing with later updates.

reporting-service.title: PDF reports displayed blank charts
reporting-service.description: Users downloaded PDF reports with empty chart areas while tables appeared normally. Reporting-service render failures were detected through an increase in chart rendering errors.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A rendering library update removed a font required by the chart renderer. Restoring the font package and restarting the rendering workers fixed the PDFs.

reporting-service.title: Audit report exports omitted some permission changes
reporting-service.description: Administrators found that audit exports did not include all changes to user permissions. An internal reconciliation check identified missing entries in reporting-service.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A corrupted ingestion checkpoint caused some audit events to be skipped. The checkpoint was repaired and the missing events were reprocessed.

reporting-service.title: Users received another user's report download
reporting-service.description: Some users downloading a recently generated report received a file created by a different user in the same organization. A support report prompted the reporting-service team to disable the affected download path.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: The download cache used a report type as its key without including the requesting user. The cache key was corrected and existing cached files were invalidated.

reporting-service.title: Workforce reports failed during a network routing change
reporting-service.description: Users saw intermittent failures when running reports that combined employee and schedule data. Reporting-service network alerts showed dropped connections to the schedule data store.
reporting-service.resolution_summary: A routing change sent some traffic through a path that could not reach the data store. Reverting the route restored stable connections and report generation.

data-pipeline.title: Employee updates stopped appearing in workforce reports
data-pipeline.description: Managers saw outdated employee details in workforce reports. The data-pipeline stopped processing updates after a deployment, and an alert on the growing ingestion backlog detected the problem.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The deployment introduced a timestamp parser that rejected valid update events. The team rolled back the change and replayed the backlog.

data-pipeline.title: Time-off records were missing from analytics exports
data-pipeline.description: Analytics exports omitted newly approved time-off requests. A customer reported the discrepancy, and the data-pipeline team confirmed that those events were not reaching the export dataset.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A configuration change excluded the time-off event category from ingestion. The team corrected the filter and reprocessed the affected events.

data-pipeline.title: Payroll data ingestion failed after a certificate expired
data-pipeline.description: Payroll reporting data stopped updating because the data-pipeline could not connect to its source. Connection failure alerts detected the interruption.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The certificate used to authenticate the connection had expired. The team renewed it and resumed ingestion from the last successful checkpoint.

data-pipeline.title: Workforce events accumulated during message broker outage
data-pipeline.description: Recent shift and attendance changes were delayed in downstream reports. Backlog monitoring alerted the team while the message broker used by data-pipeline was unavailable.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The broker dependency experienced an outage that prevented consumers from receiving events. After the broker recovered, the pipeline drained the backlog.

data-pipeline.title: Large payroll batches caused pipeline workers to run out of memory
data-pipeline.description: Payroll export datasets remained incomplete after large batches were submitted. Worker restart alerts and failed batch counts revealed the problem.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: Workers loaded entire batches into memory before transforming them. The team changed the transformation to process smaller chunks and retried the failed batches.

data-pipeline.title: Employee data refresh slowed by an unindexed database query
data-pipeline.description: Employee changes took much longer than usual to appear in reports. The data-pipeline freshness alert fired, and operators found that source queries were taking several minutes.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A frequently used change-tracking query lacked an index for its filter. The team added the index and verified that refresh times returned to normal.

data-pipeline.title: Department names were corrupted in workforce exports
data-pipeline.description: Some workforce exports showed truncated department names and misplaced fields. A customer noticed the malformed rows and reported them to support.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A parser treated delimiter characters inside quoted department names as field boundaries. The team corrected the parser and rebuilt the affected exports.

data-pipeline.title: Pipeline could not resolve the storage endpoint
data-pipeline.description: Completed transformations could not be written to the analytics store, leaving reports stale. Write failure alerts led the team to repeated name resolution errors in data-pipeline.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the record for the storage endpoint. The record was restored and pending writes were retried.

data-pipeline.title: New payroll files were rejected by the ingestion reader
data-pipeline.description: Payroll files arrived in storage but did not appear in downstream datasets. A file-processing alert showed that data-pipeline could list the files but could not read them.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed read access from the pipeline's service account. The team restored access and processed the waiting files.

data-pipeline.title: Benefits imports missed records after an API pagination change
data-pipeline.description: Benefits reports contained only the first page of records from an external provider. A reconciliation check detected a lower record count than expected.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The provider changed its pagination response, but the data-pipeline connector still expected the old format. The team updated the connector and reran the import.

data-pipeline.title: Scheduled attendance aggregation did not run
data-pipeline.description: Attendance summaries remained unchanged despite new clock events. A missed-job alert showed that the data-pipeline aggregation had not started.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The scheduler rejected an invalid recurrence configuration introduced during a schedule update. The team corrected the schedule and ran the missed aggregation.

data-pipeline.title: New hire events failed validation after a schema change
data-pipeline.description: Recently added employees were absent from downstream headcount reports. Validation error alerts showed that data-pipeline was rejecting their events.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The source added a new employment type that the pipeline's validation rules did not recognize. The team updated the allowed values and replayed the rejected events.

data-pipeline.title: Duplicate shift records appeared in labor reports
data-pipeline.description: Some labor reports counted the same shift twice after events were retried. A reconciliation check detected more shift records in the reporting dataset than in the source.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The deduplication logic treated retried events as new records when their delivery identifiers changed. The team deduplicated by the stable source event identifier and rebuilt the affected data.

data-pipeline.title: Employee change capture stopped after log retention was exhausted
data-pipeline.description: Employee updates stopped flowing into analytics while source transactions continued. A data-pipeline lag alert identified that change capture had fallen behind.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A stalled consumer exceeded the source database's retained change-log window and could no longer resume from its checkpoint. The team restored the consumer and performed a fresh snapshot to fill the gap.
