data-pipeline.title: New tenant data could not be written to partitioned tables
data-pipeline.description: Reports for newly onboarded tenants remained empty even though their events were ingested. Pipeline write alerts showed failures when creating destination partitions.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The analytics store had reached its configured partition limit. The team consolidated partitions, raised the limit and replayed the failed writes.

data-pipeline.title: Historical payroll reprocessing failed because source files were deleted
data-pipeline.description: A requested payroll dataset rebuild could not complete for older records. Operators detected missing source files while investigating the failed data-pipeline job.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A storage lifecycle rule deleted source files before the required retention period ended. The team corrected the rule, restored available files from backup and reran the rebuild.

data-pipeline.title: Late clock events were excluded from attendance totals
data-pipeline.description: Some attendance totals were lower than the underlying clock records. A reconciliation alert found events that arrived after data-pipeline had finalized their aggregation window.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The allowed lateness setting was shorter than the delay caused by intermittent source synchronization. The team increased the window and recomputed affected attendance totals.

data-pipeline.title: Rejected events stopped being recorded when the error queue filled
data-pipeline.description: Invalid employee events were not available for review, and processing of later events stalled. An alert on the data-pipeline error queue showed that it had reached its size limit.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A burst of validation failures filled the queue, and the pipeline could not acknowledge subsequent events. The team expanded queue capacity, corrected the validation issue and reprocessed the stalled events.

data-pipeline.title: Historical backfill blocked current workforce updates
data-pipeline.description: Current workforce reports became stale while a historical data rebuild was running. Freshness alerts and database lock monitoring showed that data-pipeline writes were waiting.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: The backfill held locks on destination tables for too long. The team stopped it, released the locks and restarted it in smaller batches.

data-pipeline.title: Currency amounts were rounded incorrectly in payroll analytics
data-pipeline.description: Payroll analytics showed small discrepancies in some deduction totals. A reconciliation check comparing pipeline output with source payroll records detected the differences.
data-pipeline.resolution_summary: A transformation converted decimal amounts to floating-point values before aggregation. The team switched to decimal arithmetic and recalculated the affected totals.

message-queue.title: Payroll calculation messages remained unprocessed after a deploy
message-queue.description: Payroll runs stayed in the calculating state because workers could not read new queue messages. Support noticed the delay after several customers reported stalled payroll runs.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A deploy changed the message envelope without updating the worker parser. Rolling back the change and replaying the affected messages restored processing.

message-queue.title: Timecard approval notifications arrived hours late
message-queue.description: Employees received timecard approval notifications well after managers approved their hours. Queue age alerts showed that notification messages were accumulating.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A configuration change reduced the notification consumer count to one. Restoring the intended consumer count cleared the backlog.

message-queue.title: Queue clients could not connect after a certificate expired
message-queue.description: HR updates and payroll tasks stopped progressing because producers could not connect to the message broker. Connection failure alerts and customer reports exposed the interruption.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The broker's transport certificate had expired. Renewing the certificate and restarting the affected clients restored connections.

message-queue.title: Employee onboarding tasks stalled during broker storage outage
message-queue.description: New hires remained in onboarding because their setup events were not delivered to downstream workers. Monitoring detected failed writes to the broker's storage dependency.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The broker's storage dependency became unavailable, preventing durable message writes. After storage recovered, the team restarted affected broker nodes and replayed retained events.

message-queue.title: Shift update messages were rejected when the queue reached capacity
message-queue.description: Some schedule changes did not reach employee calendars because the queue rejected new messages. Capacity alerts showed that queued messages had filled the broker's available disk space.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A surge in shift updates exceeded the broker's provisioned storage capacity. Adding capacity and draining the backlog allowed rejected updates to be submitted again.

message-queue.title: Queue workers restarted repeatedly while processing large payroll batches
message-queue.description: Large payroll batches made little progress while smaller batches completed normally. Restart alerts showed that message workers were repeatedly running out of memory.
message-queue.resolution_summary: Workers loaded entire payroll batches into memory before publishing their messages. Processing the batches in smaller chunks stopped the restarts and allowed the remaining work to finish.

message-queue.title: Leave request events were delayed by a slow queue lookup
message-queue.description: Managers saw leave requests appear in their approval lists much later than expected. Queue processing alerts pointed to increasing database lookup times.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A missing index made the queue's message deduplication query scan an increasingly large table. Adding the index reduced lookup time and cleared the backlog.

message-queue.title: Corrupted queue messages blocked benefits enrollment updates
message-queue.description: Some benefits enrollment changes remained pending because their queue partition stopped advancing. An alert on a stationary consumer offset revealed repeated failures on the same message.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A malformed payload had been written to the partition and could not be deserialized. The team isolated the corrupted message and republished the enrollment update from the source record.

message-queue.title: Workers could not resolve the message broker hostname
message-queue.description: Queued employee profile changes stopped reaching downstream services. Connection alerts showed that workers could not resolve the broker hostname.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A DNS record for the broker had been removed during a configuration update. Restoring the record and refreshing client caches reestablished delivery.

message-queue.title: Payroll workers could not read from their queue
message-queue.description: Payroll runs remained queued even though messages were successfully published. Worker logs showed repeated authorization failures when consumers attempted to read the queue.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A permissions update removed the consumer role's read access. Restoring the queue permission allowed workers to resume processing.

message-queue.title: Employment verification messages failed after a provider API change
message-queue.description: Employment verification requests stayed pending because their queued delivery attempts failed. Retry alerts and provider response errors revealed the problem.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The verification provider changed a required request field, but the queue consumer still sent the old format. Updating the consumer to use the new field allowed failed requests to be retried.

message-queue.title: Dead-letter messages were not replayed after a worker fix
message-queue.description: Some employee document notifications remained missing after the original processing error was corrected. Support traced the missing notifications to messages still sitting in the dead-letter queue.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The scheduled dead-letter replay job had failed because its checkpoint file was unavailable. Repairing the checkpoint and rerunning the job delivered the retained messages.

message-queue.title: Employees received duplicate payslip notifications
message-queue.description: Some employees received the same payslip notification more than once. Customer reports led the team to find repeated deliveries of identical queue messages.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The notification consumer sent messages before recording its processing checkpoint, so a restart caused them to be delivered again. Adding an idempotency check prevented duplicate notifications during retries.

message-queue.title: Shift changes were applied out of order
message-queue.description: Some employees saw an older shift assignment replace a newer one. Support compared the schedule history with queue delivery logs and found the updates had been processed out of order.
message-queue.resolution_summary: Related shift events were routed to different partitions, allowing consumers to process them concurrently. Routing events by shift identifier preserved their order.

message-queue.title: Queue retries overwhelmed the time tracking service
message-queue.description: Time entries took longer to appear while the queue repeatedly retried failed submissions. Monitoring showed a sharp increase in retry traffic against the time tracking service.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The retry policy had no delay between attempts, amplifying a brief downstream failure. Adding exponential backoff reduced the load and let the service recover.

message-queue.title: Delayed reminders were delivered immediately
message-queue.description: Employees received reminders as soon as they were created rather than near their scheduled shifts. Customer reports and message timestamps showed that the queue was ignoring the intended delay.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The delayed-delivery setting was disabled on the reminder queue. Reenabling it restored scheduled delivery for newly created reminders.

message-queue.title: Queue messages expired before payroll workers could process them
message-queue.description: Some payroll adjustment requests never reached processing after a period of heavy demand. Reconciliation checks found that published messages were missing from both the active queue and completed results.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The queue's message retention period was shorter than the backlog delay. Increasing retention and resubmitting the missing adjustments restored the affected requests.

message-queue.title: One tenant's bulk import delayed other tenants' HR updates
message-queue.description: Employee profile updates took unusually long to appear for several tenants. Queue metrics showed that a single bulk import occupied most consumer capacity.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The queue had no per-tenant processing limits, so the import monopolized shared workers. Adding tenant-level limits and draining the backlog restored normal throughput.

message-queue.title: Queue consumers stopped after a malformed retry header
message-queue.description: Some leave and attendance updates remained pending while affected consumers repeatedly restarted. Worker crash alerts identified a message with an unexpected retry header value.
message-queue.resolution_summary: The consumer assumed the retry header was always numeric and crashed when it encountered text. Validating the header and routing invalid messages to the dead-letter queue restored processing.

message-queue.title: Messages were routed to the wrong notification queue
message-queue.description: Employees did not receive some schedule change alerts, although the updates appeared in the application. Delivery checks found the corresponding messages in a queue with no matching consumer.
message-queue.resolution_summary: A routing rule used an incorrect event type for schedule changes. Correcting the rule and moving the stranded messages to the intended queue restored notifications.

file-storage.title: Large payroll export uploads failed after a release
file-storage.description: Payroll administrators saw upload errors when saving large export files, while smaller files continued to work. Support detected the pattern after several administrators reported missing exports.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced an incorrect multipart upload threshold. The change was rolled back and the threshold was corrected.

file-storage.title: Employee document downloads returned access denied
file-storage.description: Employees could see document names but received an access denied message when downloading them. The issue was detected by an alert on failed storage requests.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A configuration change removed read access from the service account used for downloads. Restoring the permission resolved the failures.

file-storage.title: File uploads failed because a storage certificate expired
file-storage.description: Users could not upload employee documents because connections to the storage endpoint failed. An alert on connection errors revealed that the endpoint certificate had expired.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The certificate renewal process had failed silently. The certificate was renewed and monitoring was added for future renewal failures.

file-storage.title: Stored files were unavailable during an object storage outage
file-storage.description: Users received errors when opening previously uploaded files across payroll and employee records. The support team detected the issue through download failure alerts and confirmed that the storage provider was unavailable.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The object storage provider experienced an outage that prevented file reads. Downloads recovered when the provider restored the affected service.

file-storage.title: Concurrent document uploads exhausted file-storage memory
file-storage.description: Users experienced stalled uploads and intermittent errors while adding employee documents. Memory alerts showed that file-storage workers were restarting under a spike in concurrent uploads.
file-storage.resolution_summary: Workers buffered entire files in memory instead of streaming them to storage. Streaming was enabled and upload concurrency was limited.

file-storage.title: Opening employee document lists became slow for large tenants
file-storage.description: Administrators waited unusually long for employee document lists to load, and some requests timed out. Latency alerts identified the slowdown in file metadata lookups.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A metadata query scanned a large table because it lacked an index on the tenant and employee fields. Adding the index restored normal response times.

file-storage.title: Downloaded policy documents contained truncated content
file-storage.description: Some policy documents downloaded successfully but could not be opened because their contents were incomplete. An administrator reported the problem after comparing an uploaded file with its downloaded copy.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A retry bug marked interrupted transfers as complete. The upload logic was corrected, and affected documents were restored from verified copies where available.

file-storage.title: File-storage could not resolve the object storage endpoint
file-storage.description: Uploads and downloads failed intermittently because file-storage could not find the storage endpoint. Connection error alerts led the team to repeated DNS lookup failures.
file-storage.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS configuration pointed workers to an unavailable resolver. Restoring the resolver configuration returned file access to normal.

file-storage.title: New uploads remained unavailable after a scanning API change
file-storage.description: Employee documents remained in a scanning state and could not be opened after upload. A growing queue alert revealed that scan results were not being processed.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The scanning provider changed the format of its response, which the result parser did not accept. Updating the parser allowed queued files to finish scanning.

file-storage.title: Expired temporary files accumulated after cleanup job stopped
file-storage.description: Temporary upload files were not removed after their retention period, consuming storage and putting new uploads at risk. A capacity alert exposed the growing collection of expired files.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The scheduled cleanup job was disabled by an invalid schedule configuration. The schedule was corrected and the backlog was removed.

file-storage.title: Preview images showed the wrong page of uploaded documents
file-storage.description: Users previewing multipage employee documents sometimes saw an image from a different page. Support reproduced the issue after administrators reported misleading previews.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The preview cache key omitted the page number. The key was corrected and cached previews were regenerated.

file-storage.title: Download links expired immediately after being created
file-storage.description: Users received expired-link errors when opening newly generated file downloads. A synthetic download check detected the failures before support reports arrived.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The clock on the link-signing workers was ahead of the storage service clock. Time synchronization was restored and link generation resumed normally.

file-storage.title: Renaming an attachment made it disappear from employee records
file-storage.description: Administrators who renamed an attachment could no longer see it in the employee record, although the stored file still existed. Support detected the issue after reports of missing attachments.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The rename operation cleared the employee association in the metadata record. The update was corrected and affected associations were restored from audit records.

file-storage.title: File uploads stalled when the message queue filled
file-storage.description: Uploads appeared to complete but remained in a processing state and were unavailable to users. Queue depth monitoring showed that completion messages were no longer being accepted.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A consumer had stopped acknowledging messages, causing the queue to reach its limit. The consumer was restarted and the queued messages were processed.

file-storage.title: Deleted files continued to appear in document search
file-storage.description: Users saw deleted employee files in search results, although attempts to open them failed. Support identified the mismatch after administrators reported stale results.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The search indexing worker was not receiving deletion events. Event delivery was repaired and the search index was rebuilt.

file-storage.title: Files with non-English names could not be uploaded
file-storage.description: Users received an error when uploading files whose names contained certain non-English characters. Support reproduced the issue using filenames submitted in customer reports.
file-storage.resolution_summary: A filename validation rule incorrectly accepted only a limited character set. The rule was updated to support valid Unicode filenames.

file-storage.title: Document previews failed for password-protected files
file-storage.description: Preview requests for password-protected documents failed and delayed previews for other files. Worker saturation alerts revealed that the conversion processes were hanging.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The preview converter waited indefinitely for a password prompt it could not display. A timeout and an unsupported-file response were added.

file-storage.title: Resumed uploads created duplicate employee attachments
file-storage.description: Users who retried interrupted uploads sometimes saw the same attachment listed twice. Support found the pattern while investigating reports of duplicate onboarding documents.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The upload completion handler did not check whether a retry had already created a metadata record. An idempotency check was added and duplicate records were removed.

file-storage.title: File downloads failed after a storage bucket migration
file-storage.description: Users could not download files uploaded before a storage migration, while newer files remained accessible. Download error alerts showed that requests for older objects were going to the wrong location.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The migration changed object locations without updating the corresponding metadata. The metadata was corrected and download routing was verified.

file-storage.title: Retention policy removed employee files too early
file-storage.description: Some employee documents disappeared before the configured retention period had elapsed. An administrator noticed the missing files during a records review.
file-storage.resolution_summary: The retention calculation used the upload time instead of the employee's separation time for the affected policy. The calculation was fixed and recoverable files were restored from backup.

web-frontend.title: Payroll review page stays blank after navigation
web-frontend.description: Payroll administrators saw a blank page when opening the review step, preventing them from checking payroll before submission. The issue was detected by a rise in browser errors and support reports.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A frontend deploy introduced a missing import in the payroll route. Reverting the change and rebuilding the bundle restored the page.

web-frontend.title: Employees cannot open payslips from the portal
web-frontend.description: Employees saw a security warning instead of their payslips when opening the document viewer. Support reports and a certificate expiry alert exposed the problem.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the document viewer had expired. Renewing the certificate and reloading the viewer configuration restored access.

web-frontend.title: Sign-in page loops back after successful authentication
web-frontend.description: Users who entered valid credentials were returned to the sign-in page instead of reaching their dashboard. Login completion metrics and user reports revealed the loop.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the session cookie to an incorrect path. Correcting the cookie path allowed the frontend to retain authenticated sessions.

web-frontend.title: Schedule calendar fails to load for all users
web-frontend.description: Managers and employees saw a loading spinner instead of their shift calendar. Monitoring detected failed requests from the calendar page, and users reported that they could not check upcoming shifts.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: An outage in the scheduling dependency caused its requests from the frontend to fail. The dependency recovered, and a retry control was added to the calendar.

web-frontend.title: Employee directory becomes unresponsive for large tenants
web-frontend.description: The employee directory froze in the browser for tenants with large workforces. Support reports and browser performance traces showed that users could not reliably search or open profiles.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend rendered every employee row at once, exhausting browser memory. Virtualizing the list reduced memory use and restored directory responsiveness.

web-frontend.title: Time-off balances take too long to appear
web-frontend.description: Employees opening the time-off page waited a long time for their balances and sometimes saw a timeout message. Frontend latency alerts and user reports identified the delay.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The balance endpoint called by the page used a slow database query. Adding an index and adjusting the query restored normal page load times.

web-frontend.title: Profile editor crashes for employees with malformed preferences
web-frontend.description: Some employees saw an error screen when opening their profile editor and could not update their contact details. Error monitoring showed that the failures were limited to profiles with a particular saved preference.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A previous migration had stored invalid values in the affected preference field. Repairing the records and adding validation to the editor prevented the crash.

web-frontend.title: Frontend assets fail to load because of DNS resolution errors
web-frontend.description: Users intermittently received an unstyled page or a loading error when opening the portal. Synthetic browser checks detected failures to resolve the hostname serving frontend assets.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed a required asset hostname record. Restoring the record allowed browsers to download the application bundles.

web-frontend.title: Managers cannot approve timesheets from the web portal
web-frontend.description: Managers saw a permission error when selecting Approve on submitted timesheets. Support reports showed that the affected managers could still view their teams' timesheets.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A permission mapping change omitted the approval action from the manager role. Restoring the mapping allowed the frontend approval request to succeed.

web-frontend.title: Address lookup suggestions disappear during employee onboarding
web-frontend.description: New employees could type an address but no longer saw suggested matches in the onboarding form. A drop in address lookup success and support reports brought the issue to attention.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The address lookup provider changed the response format, and the frontend could no longer parse suggestions. Updating the integration to handle the new format restored the list.

web-frontend.title: Dashboard shows outdated leave totals
web-frontend.description: Managers saw leave totals that did not reflect recently approved requests on the dashboard. A support investigation found that the totals differed from the leave detail page.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The scheduled job that refreshed the dashboard summary had stopped running. Restarting the job and adding a freshness alert restored current totals.

web-frontend.title: Payroll export button downloads an empty file
web-frontend.description: Payroll administrators received empty files when using the export button, despite seeing populated payroll rows on screen. The issue was detected through support reports and a failed export check.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend passed an incorrect filter value to the export endpoint. Correcting the request parameter restored populated exports.

web-frontend.title: Shift editor loses unsaved changes after a browser refresh
web-frontend.description: Managers lost draft shift edits after refreshing the schedule editor, even though the page indicated that a draft had been saved. Support reports led to reproduction of the issue.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The draft recovery code read a different browser storage key from the one used to save edits. Aligning the keys restored draft recovery.

web-frontend.title: Mobile users cannot submit expense claims
web-frontend.description: On narrow screens, the expense claim submit button appeared behind the bottom navigation and could not be tapped. User reports and mobile browser testing exposed the layout problem.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A stylesheet change gave the navigation bar an incorrect stacking order. Adjusting the layout and adding a mobile viewport test restored access to the button.

web-frontend.title: Tax withholding form rejects valid decimal amounts
web-frontend.description: Employees entering decimal withholding amounts saw a validation error even when the amount was valid. Support reports showed that whole-number entries still worked.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: A frontend validation rule accepted only integers after a form update. Updating the rule to accept supported decimal amounts fixed the form.

web-frontend.title: Newly published handbook links return a not found page
web-frontend.description: Employees clicking handbook links from the portal saw a not found page instead of the document. Support noticed that older handbook links still worked and reported the discrepancy.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend router did not recognize a new document path format. Adding the route and covering it with a navigation test restored the links.

web-frontend.title: Open enrollment page displays the wrong benefit selections
web-frontend.description: Some employees briefly saw selections from another household member when switching between dependent records. A user report and browser investigation revealed that the displayed data could be misleading during enrollment.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend reused a cached response without including the dependent identifier in the cache key. Correcting the key and clearing affected cached entries fixed the display.

web-frontend.title: Clock-in button remains disabled after location permission is granted
web-frontend.description: Employees using the web time clock could grant browser location access but still could not clock in. Support reports and browser logs showed that the button never became active.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend failed to update its permission state after the browser returned a location. Fixing the state update allowed eligible employees to clock in.

web-frontend.title: Search results disappear while typing employee names
web-frontend.description: Managers searching the employee directory saw relevant results appear and then disappear while typing. Support reproduced the issue when searches were entered quickly.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: Older search responses could arrive after newer ones and overwrite the current results. Ignoring responses for superseded queries stabilized the search list.

web-frontend.title: Portal intermittently fails to load during shift changes
web-frontend.description: Employees opening the portal around shift changes sometimes received a gateway error instead of the home page. Request metrics and user reports showed that failures increased during traffic spikes.
web-frontend.resolution_summary: The frontend serving tier had too few instances to handle the concurrent connections. Increasing capacity and adjusting scaling thresholds reduced the errors.

scheduling-service.title: Overnight shifts appear on the wrong day after editing
scheduling-service.description: Managers saw some overnight shifts move to the previous day after saving an edit. Employees received schedules with incorrect shift dates. Support reports and a spike in schedule corrections revealed the issue.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A deployment converted shift start times to UTC before applying the workplace time zone. The change was rolled back and affected shifts were corrected.

scheduling-service.title: Managers cannot create shifts more than two weeks ahead
scheduling-service.description: The scheduling-service rejected shifts beyond a two-week planning window, even for workplaces that normally planned months ahead. Managers reported the unexpected validation error while preparing future rosters.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change set the maximum scheduling horizon too low. Restoring the intended limit allowed future shifts to be created.

scheduling-service.title: Calendar subscriptions stop receiving schedule updates
scheduling-service.description: Employees who subscribed to their schedules in external calendars stopped seeing new shifts. The scheduling-service reported connection failures when calendar clients requested feeds. Monitoring detected the failed feed requests.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used by the calendar feed endpoint had expired. Renewing the certificate restored access to schedule feeds.

scheduling-service.title: Employee names disappear from schedule views
scheduling-service.description: Schedules loaded with blank employee names, making it difficult for managers to identify shift assignments. Alerts showed that the scheduling-service could not retrieve employee details.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The employee directory dependency was unavailable, and the schedule view did not handle lookup failures gracefully. The directory was restored and the scheduling-service was updated to show cached names during short outages.

scheduling-service.title: Recurring schedule generation fails for large workplaces
scheduling-service.description: Managers creating recurring schedules for large workplaces saw requests fail before all shifts were generated. Memory alerts and incomplete schedule reports exposed the problem.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The recurrence generator held every shift in memory before writing any of them. Processing shifts in bounded batches reduced memory use and allowed generation to complete.

scheduling-service.title: Open shift search takes too long to load
scheduling-service.description: Employees waited a long time for available shifts to appear, and some searches timed out. The scheduling-service detected elevated query latency on the open shift endpoint.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned the shift assignment table without a suitable index. Adding an index and revising the query restored normal search times.

scheduling-service.title: Completed shift swaps still show the original assignments
scheduling-service.description: Employees received swap approval messages, but their schedules continued to show the original assignments. A manager reported the mismatch, and an audit found other affected swaps.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A failed data migration had left inconsistent assignment references for some swaps. The references were repaired and the migration was corrected.

scheduling-service.title: Location filters fail when building schedules
scheduling-service.description: Managers could not filter schedules by workplace location because the location list failed to load. Connection errors in the scheduling-service pointed to failures resolving the location service.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: An incorrect DNS record directed requests to an unavailable address. Correcting the record and clearing cached lookups restored location filtering.

scheduling-service.title: Managers receive permission errors when publishing rosters
scheduling-service.description: Managers who could edit schedules received permission errors when they tried to publish them. Support reports showed that the failures affected multiple workplaces.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A permissions update omitted the publish action from the manager role. Restoring the action allowed authorized managers to publish rosters.

scheduling-service.title: Shift reminder text messages are not delivered
scheduling-service.description: Employees stopped receiving text reminders for upcoming shifts, although reminders appeared as queued in the scheduling-service. Delivery monitoring detected a sustained increase in provider rejections.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The messaging provider changed a required field in its API. Updating the reminder payload and retrying eligible messages restored delivery.

scheduling-service.title: Recurring shifts are missing from newly opened weeks
scheduling-service.description: Managers found that recurring shifts had not appeared in upcoming schedule weeks. An alert showed that the scheduled generation job had not completed.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The job stopped when it encountered a deleted schedule template and did not continue with the remaining templates. Skipping invalid templates and rerunning the job generated the missing shifts.

scheduling-service.title: Availability changes are not reflected in shift assignment
scheduling-service.description: Managers continued to see old employee availability after employees submitted changes. Affected employees reported being assigned during times they had marked unavailable.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: Availability updates did not invalidate the scheduling-service cache. Correcting cache invalidation and clearing stale entries restored current availability.

scheduling-service.title: Two employees are assigned the same open shift
scheduling-service.description: Some open shifts showed two employees as assigned after both attempted to claim them at nearly the same time. Managers reported the conflicts during roster review.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The claim operation checked availability and created assignments without an atomic lock. Adding a database constraint and transactional claim handling prevented duplicate assignments.

scheduling-service.title: Employees receive duplicate shift change notifications
scheduling-service.description: Employees received multiple identical notifications when a manager changed a shift. Notification volume monitoring and employee reports revealed the duplicates.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A message consumer retried events after processing them without recording that they were complete. Adding idempotent event handling stopped repeated notifications.

scheduling-service.title: Shift durations are incorrect across daylight saving transitions
scheduling-service.description: Shifts spanning a daylight saving transition displayed the wrong duration in schedule summaries. A manager noticed the discrepancy while reviewing staffing hours.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The duration calculation used local clock time rather than elapsed time between instants. Correcting the calculation fixed affected summaries.

scheduling-service.title: Eligible employees cannot see open shifts
scheduling-service.description: Employees who met the workplace rules saw an empty open shift list. Support compared affected accounts with the roster and found that published shifts existed.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A feature flag enabled a new eligibility filter with an incorrect default. Disabling the flag and correcting the default restored visibility.

scheduling-service.title: Schedule imports fail when uploading roster files
scheduling-service.description: Managers could not import roster files and saw an upload failure before validation began. The scheduling-service logged errors writing temporary import files.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The temporary file storage quota had been exhausted by files from completed imports. Clearing old files and adding cleanup after each import restored uploads.

scheduling-service.title: Bulk schedule edits are rejected as too many requests
scheduling-service.description: Managers applying changes to many shifts saw some edits fail with a rate limit message. Reports showed that the failures occurred during ordinary bulk editing.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A rate limit change counted each shift in a bulk operation as a separate user request. Adjusting the limit to account for bulk operations allowed the edits to complete.

scheduling-service.title: Schedule changes do not appear until the page is refreshed
scheduling-service.description: Managers viewing the same roster did not see each other's changes in real time. Refreshing the page showed the saved changes, and connection monitoring detected frequent live update disconnects.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: A proxy configuration closed idle connections used for schedule updates too quickly. Increasing the idle timeout restored live updates.

scheduling-service.title: Holiday schedule rules leave workplaces understaffed
scheduling-service.description: Some published rosters omitted shifts on holidays even when managers had configured those shifts to run. Managers noticed the gaps during a review of upcoming coverage.
scheduling-service.resolution_summary: The rule evaluator applied the default holiday closure before checking workplace exceptions. Reordering the evaluation and regenerating affected shifts restored the intended coverage.

leave-service.title: Employees receive errors when submitting leave requests
leave-service.description: Employees saw an error after selecting dates and submitting a leave request. The requests were not saved, and support reports and an elevated error-rate alert revealed the issue.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced a null reference when a request had no optional comment. The change was rolled back and corrected to accept empty comments.

leave-service.title: Leave requests are assigned to the wrong calendar day
leave-service.description: Some employees saw approved leave appear one day earlier than the dates they selected. A tenant administrator reported the mismatch after comparing the leave calendar with employee requests.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change caused the service to interpret tenant dates in the wrong time zone. The correct time-zone setting was restored and affected calendar entries were rebuilt.

leave-service.title: Approved leave is missing from payroll exports
leave-service.description: Payroll administrators found that newly approved leave was absent from exports. A failed export alert identified repeated connection errors between leave-service and the payroll integration.
leave-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used to authenticate the integration had expired. The certificate was renewed and the missed exports were replayed.

leave-service.title: Managers cannot open the leave approval queue
leave-service.description: Managers saw a loading error instead of pending leave requests. Monitoring showed that calls to the employee hierarchy service were failing, and managers also reported the problem to support.
leave-service.resolution_summary: An outage in the employee hierarchy dependency prevented leave-service from determining approval relationships. The dependency was restored and queued requests became visible again.

leave-service.title: Team leave calendar fails for large departments
leave-service.description: Users in large departments saw the team calendar stall or fail to load. Memory alerts and repeated service restarts exposed the issue.
leave-service.resolution_summary: The calendar endpoint loaded all matching leave records into memory before filtering them. Pagination and server-side filtering reduced memory use and restored the calendar.

leave-service.title: Leave balance page takes too long to load
leave-service.description: Employees experienced long waits or timeouts when opening their leave balances. Latency alerts showed that the balance lookup was slowing as transaction history grew.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A database query scanned balance transactions without a suitable index. Adding the index and revising the query brought response times back down.

leave-service.title: Accrued leave balances show incorrect totals
leave-service.description: Some employees saw balances that did not match their recorded accruals and leave usage. A reconciliation check detected differences between transaction totals and stored balances.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A partial write left balance snapshots out of sync with their transaction records. The write was made atomic and affected snapshots were rebuilt from the transaction history.

leave-service.title: Public holidays are counted as leave days
leave-service.description: Employees saw requests charged for days that should have been excluded as public holidays. Support reports and failed holiday lookup checks identified the issue.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration error prevented leave-service from resolving the holiday calendar dependency. The DNS record was corrected and affected requests were recalculated.

leave-service.title: Employees cannot attach documents to leave requests
leave-service.description: Document uploads failed when employees tried to add supporting files to requests. An increase in storage access errors triggered an alert.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the service's ability to write attachments to storage. The required permission was restored and employees could upload their documents.

leave-service.title: Leave requests do not appear on connected calendars
leave-service.description: Approved leave remained visible in leave-service but did not appear on connected calendars. Integration failure alerts showed that calendar updates were being rejected.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A third-party calendar API changed a required field in its event payload. The integration was updated to send the new field and missed events were resynchronized.

leave-service.title: Scheduled leave accruals are not credited
leave-service.description: Employees did not receive their expected leave accruals, leaving balances lower than expected. A check for completed accrual runs alerted the operations team.
leave-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled accrual job stopped after encountering an invalid policy record. The policy was corrected, the job was rerun, and validation was added to prevent the same failure.

leave-service.title: Approving a request deducts leave twice
leave-service.description: Some employees saw two balance deductions for a single approved request. A duplicate transaction check detected the affected approvals.
leave-service.resolution_summary: Two concurrent approval submissions could both create a deduction before the request status was updated. An idempotency constraint prevented duplicate deductions, and the extra transactions were reversed.

leave-service.title: Cancelled leave remains visible on team calendars
leave-service.description: Managers continued to see cancelled requests on team calendars even though employees could see the cancellation. Support reproduced the mismatch between the request detail and calendar views.
leave-service.resolution_summary: Cancellation did not invalidate the cached calendar entry. Cache invalidation was added and stale entries were cleared.

leave-service.title: Leave status updates stop reaching payroll
leave-service.description: Payroll continued to show outdated leave statuses after requests were approved or cancelled. Queue lag monitoring detected that updates were accumulating.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A malformed message repeatedly failed processing and blocked the update queue. The message was moved aside, processing resumed, and invalid messages were routed to a separate queue.

leave-service.title: Partial-day leave is rounded up incorrectly
leave-service.description: Employees requesting fractional days saw a larger deduction than the amount requested. An administrator noticed the discrepancy while reviewing balance transactions.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A data migration converted fractional leave quantities to whole numbers before calculation. The precision was restored and affected deductions were recalculated.

leave-service.title: Eligible employees cannot select parental leave
leave-service.description: Some employees could not find the parental leave type when creating a request. Support traced the reports to employees whose leave policies included that entitlement.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A feature flag was configured to hide the leave type for tenants that should have had access. The flag rules were corrected and eligibility checks were verified.

leave-service.title: Leave approval notifications are rejected
leave-service.description: Managers stopped receiving notifications about pending leave requests, although the requests were saved. Delivery failure alerts identified repeated authentication errors from the notification service.
leave-service.resolution_summary: A signing secret was rotated in leave-service but not in the receiving service. Both services were synchronized and failed notifications were retried.

leave-service.title: Bulk leave approvals fail intermittently
leave-service.description: Managers approving several requests at once saw some approvals fail and remain pending. Database monitoring reported an increase in deadlocks during bulk approval attempts.
leave-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent approval operations locked employee balance rows in inconsistent order. The lock order was standardized and failed approvals could be retried.

leave-service.title: Managers see only part of their team's leave requests
leave-service.description: Managers with many direct reports found that some pending requests were missing from their approval list. A support investigation reproduced the problem for large teams.
leave-service.resolution_summary: The hierarchy lookup returned multiple pages, but leave-service processed only the first page. The lookup was updated to retrieve all pages before building the approval list.

leave-service.title: Overnight leave requests show the wrong duration after a clock change
leave-service.description: Employees saw incorrect durations for overnight leave spanning a daylight saving time change. A validation report comparing requested hours with scheduled hours flagged the affected requests.
leave-service.resolution_summary: The duration calculation assumed every local day had the same number of hours. It was changed to account for time-zone transitions, and affected durations were recalculated.

tax-service.title: Federal withholding calculations return zero for supplemental wages
tax-service.description: Payroll administrators saw zero federal withholding on some supplemental wage payments. The incorrect previews delayed payroll approvals. A reconciliation alert detected a mismatch between regular and supplemental withholding totals.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A deploy mapped supplemental wages to an unsupported calculation category. The mapping was corrected and affected calculations were rerun.

tax-service.title: Tax calculations use an outdated state unemployment rate
tax-service.description: Employers saw incorrect state unemployment tax amounts in payroll previews. Payroll teams had to review affected runs before submitting them. A rate comparison check flagged the discrepancy.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change pointed the rate loader to an older rate table. The correct table was restored and cached rates were refreshed.

tax-service.title: State tax filings fail during secure connection setup
tax-service.description: Submitted state tax filings remained pending instead of reaching the tax authority gateway. Filing status alerts notified the operations team of repeated connection failures.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The client certificate used by tax-service had expired. A replacement certificate was installed and pending filings were retried.

tax-service.title: Employee tax jurisdiction lookup fails for new addresses
tax-service.description: Employees could not complete tax setup after entering new work addresses. Support reports and an increase in lookup errors revealed the problem.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The external address validation dependency was unavailable. Tax-service queued failed lookups for retry, and processing resumed when the dependency recovered.

tax-service.title: Bulk tax form generation stops before all forms are created
tax-service.description: Large employers received only some of their requested employee tax forms. The generation job restarted repeatedly, and a memory usage alert detected the failures.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The form generator loaded every employee record into memory at once. Processing was changed to use bounded batches, and incomplete jobs were rerun.

tax-service.title: Tax liability reports take several minutes to load
tax-service.description: Payroll administrators experienced long waits when opening tax liability reports. Some report requests timed out before displaying results. Database monitoring showed a sharp increase in query duration.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A report query scanned the entire tax transaction table because an index was missing. Adding the index restored normal response times.

tax-service.title: Employees receive duplicate local tax deductions
tax-service.description: Some payroll previews showed the same local tax deduction twice. Payroll administrators reported higher-than-expected deductions during review.
tax-service.resolution_summary: Duplicate jurisdiction records had been introduced during a data import. The duplicates were removed, the import validation was tightened, and affected calculations were rerun.

tax-service.title: Tax filing status checks cannot reach the filing gateway
tax-service.description: Tax filing statuses stopped updating even though submissions had been accepted. A connectivity alert detected repeated failures to resolve the gateway hostname.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A DNS configuration change removed the required gateway record. Restoring the record allowed status checks to resume.

tax-service.title: Tax-service cannot save completed employee tax forms
tax-service.description: Generated tax forms failed to appear in employee document lists. Job failure alerts showed that uploads were being rejected.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A permissions change removed the service account's ability to write to form storage. The required permission was restored and failed uploads were retried.

tax-service.title: Tax identification number validation rejects valid businesses
tax-service.description: Employers entering valid tax identification numbers received validation errors. Support tickets and a rise in rejected validations exposed the issue.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The external validation provider changed a response field used by tax-service. The response parser was updated to support the new field.

tax-service.title: Quarterly tax deposit reminders are not sent
tax-service.description: Payroll administrators did not receive expected reminders for upcoming tax deposits. The missing reminders were found during a routine review of notification counts.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled reminder job stopped after encountering an unhandled empty result. The job was fixed and the missed reminders were sent.

tax-service.title: Withholding previews continue to use a previous employee election
tax-service.description: Employees saw withholding previews based on their old tax elections after saving changes. Payroll administrators noticed the mismatch when reviewing employee records.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The election update did not invalidate the calculation cache. Cache invalidation was added and stale entries were cleared.

tax-service.title: One malformed filing blocks later tax filing messages
tax-service.description: Tax filings accumulated in the processing queue and remained in a pending state. Queue age alerts showed that newer filings were not being processed.
tax-service.resolution_summary: A malformed message was repeatedly retried at the front of the queue. The message was moved to a dead-letter queue and consumers were updated to isolate similar failures.

tax-service.title: Concurrent payroll runs leave tax calculations incomplete
tax-service.description: Some payroll runs stalled while calculating employer tax liabilities. A database lock alert and payroll support reports identified the affected runs.
tax-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent updates acquired liability records in inconsistent order, causing deadlocks. The updates were changed to use a consistent order and stalled calculations were retried.

tax-service.title: Tax totals differ by one cent across payroll reports
tax-service.description: Administrators saw small differences between employee tax deductions and aggregated payroll tax reports. A reconciliation check detected the inconsistent totals.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The report rounded each intermediate amount while the calculation rounded only the final total. Both paths were aligned to the same rounding rules and affected reports were regenerated.

tax-service.title: Tax deposits appear overdue immediately after submission
tax-service.description: Some employers saw overdue warnings shortly after submitting tax deposits. Support investigated after receiving reports that the submission times looked incorrect.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The deposit status check interpreted submission timestamps in the wrong time zone. Timestamp handling was corrected and affected statuses were recalculated.

tax-service.title: Employees cannot download completed tax forms
tax-service.description: Employees received errors when downloading tax forms that appeared as ready. Download failure monitoring identified the issue across multiple employers.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The form storage service was temporarily unavailable. Downloads recovered when storage was restored, and users could retry without regenerating their forms.

tax-service.title: Tax calculation requests fail after a database schema change
tax-service.description: Payroll previews returned errors when requesting tax calculations. An error rate alert triggered shortly after a database migration.
tax-service.resolution_summary: The migration renamed a column before all tax-service processes had been updated to use the new name. A compatible column was restored and the migration sequence was corrected.

tax-service.title: Employer tax rate imports fall behind during peak processing
tax-service.description: New employer tax rates took longer than expected to appear in payroll previews. Import backlog alerts showed that rate updates were accumulating.
tax-service.resolution_summary: Concurrent import workers exceeded the rate limit of the external rate provider. Worker concurrency was reduced and backlogged imports were retried.

tax-service.title: Tax-service creates amended filings for unchanged payroll runs
tax-service.description: Employers saw unexpected amended tax filings after reopening completed payroll runs. A filing volume alert showed more amendments than normal.
tax-service.resolution_summary: Change detection compared payroll records using an unstable field order. The comparison was made deterministic and incorrectly created amendments were canceled.

hr-core-service.title: Employee profile updates returned errors
hr-core-service.description: Users could not save changes to employee contact details in hr-core-service. Support reports and an increase in update errors alerted the team.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A deploy introduced an incompatible validation rule for optional address fields. Rolling back the change and correcting the validation restored updates.

hr-core-service.title: New hires were assigned the wrong default workweek
hr-core-service.description: Some new employee records showed a five-day workweek instead of the tenant's configured schedule. Administrators noticed the discrepancy while reviewing onboarding records.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A configuration change replaced tenant-specific defaults with a global default. The configuration was restored and affected records were corrected.

hr-core-service.title: Payroll exports failed certificate verification
hr-core-service.description: Payroll administrators could not download exports generated by hr-core-service. An alert on failed export requests exposed the problem.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The certificate used for the export storage connection had expired. Renewing the certificate restored access to generated files.

hr-core-service.title: Employee directory searches returned no results
hr-core-service.description: Directory searches in hr-core-service returned empty results even for known employees. Users reported the issue and search failure alerts confirmed it.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The search dependency was unavailable, and the service treated its errors as empty results. Search recovered when the dependency was restored, and error handling was changed to report failures.

hr-core-service.title: Bulk employee imports stopped before completion
hr-core-service.description: Large employee imports stalled and left some records unprocessed. The team detected the issue through import backlog alerts and administrator reports.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: Import workers exhausted available memory while loading entire files at once. Processing files in smaller batches and retrying incomplete imports resolved the issue.

hr-core-service.title: Time-off balance pages loaded slowly for large tenants
hr-core-service.description: Employees at large tenants waited unusually long to view their time-off balances in hr-core-service. Request latency alerts and user complaints revealed the slowdown.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A balance calculation query scanned the full leave transaction table. Adding an index and revising the query restored normal response times.

hr-core-service.title: Some employee job histories displayed duplicate entries
hr-core-service.description: Managers saw repeated job history entries on affected employee profiles. The discrepancy was detected during an audit of recent employee changes.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A retry defect wrote the same job change more than once after a partial failure. Duplicate entries were removed and idempotency checks were added.

hr-core-service.title: Employee document uploads failed intermittently
hr-core-service.description: Users attempting to upload employment documents received connection errors from hr-core-service. Upload failure alerts identified the intermittent pattern.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A network routing change dropped some connections to document storage. Restoring the route allowed uploads to complete.

hr-core-service.title: Managers could not approve employee profile changes
hr-core-service.description: Managers saw a permission error when approving changes submitted by their team members. Support tickets and authorization logs showed that valid approvals were being rejected.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A permission mapping omitted the manager approval action. Restoring the mapping allowed authorized managers to approve pending changes.

hr-core-service.title: Tax withholding updates failed for new employee records
hr-core-service.description: Payroll administrators could not save tax withholding details for newly created employees. The team detected the failure through support reports and elevated integration errors.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A tax service changed a required field in its API response, which hr-core-service could not parse. Updating the integration to accept the new response restored withholding updates.

hr-core-service.title: Accrued leave balances did not refresh
hr-core-service.description: Employees saw unchanged leave balances after the expected accrual run. Administrators identified the issue when reconciling balances against accrual policies.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The scheduled accrual job failed after encountering an invalid policy record. The policy was corrected, the job was rerun, and per-record error handling was added.

hr-core-service.title: Terminated employees remained visible in active rosters
hr-core-service.description: Some terminated employees continued to appear in active workforce rosters served by hr-core-service. Administrators reported the mismatch after reviewing termination records.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: Roster cache entries were not invalidated when termination status changed. The cache was refreshed and invalidation was added to the termination workflow.

hr-core-service.title: Pay rate changes were applied to the wrong effective period
hr-core-service.description: Some payroll previews showed a new pay rate for hours worked before its effective day. Payroll administrators detected the discrepancy while comparing previews with approved rate changes.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The effective-date comparison used a timestamp in the wrong time zone. The comparison was corrected to use the employee's configured payroll date, and affected previews were regenerated.

hr-core-service.title: New employee records were missing department assignments
hr-core-service.description: Employees created through bulk onboarding appeared without departments in hr-core-service. Administrators discovered the missing assignments when reviewing workforce reports.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A schema migration left the import mapping pointing to an obsolete department field. The mapping was updated and department assignments were restored from the import files.

hr-core-service.title: Workforce reports failed to generate
hr-core-service.description: Administrators received an error when requesting workforce reports from hr-core-service. Report failure alerts showed that new requests were not completing.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The report queue stopped accepting messages after reaching its configured storage limit. Clearing obsolete messages and adjusting retention restored report generation.

hr-core-service.title: Employee addresses were overwritten by stale changes
hr-core-service.description: Some employee address edits disappeared after a second administrator saved an older version of the same profile. The issue was found when users compared audit history with current records.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: Profile updates lacked a version check and allowed stale writes to overwrite newer data. Version checks were added and affected addresses were restored from audit records.

hr-core-service.title: Payroll export delivery was delayed by DNS failures
hr-core-service.description: Generated payroll exports remained pending instead of being delivered to the configured destination. Delivery alerts showed repeated failures to resolve the destination host.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: An outdated DNS record pointed to a retired endpoint. Correcting the record and retrying pending deliveries resolved the delays.

hr-core-service.title: Employees could not submit leave requests with attachments
hr-core-service.description: Leave requests with supporting documents failed to submit through hr-core-service, while requests without attachments succeeded. User reports and request logs isolated the problem to attached files.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A request size limit had been reduced below the supported attachment size. Restoring the limit allowed employees to submit affected requests.

hr-core-service.title: Work schedules showed incorrect overnight shift end times
hr-core-service.description: Overnight shifts appeared to end on the same day they started, causing incorrect scheduled-hour totals. Supervisors noticed the issue while reviewing team schedules.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: The schedule parser discarded the day offset on overnight end times. The parser was fixed and affected schedule totals were recalculated.

hr-core-service.title: Employee status changes were delayed in payroll previews
hr-core-service.description: Payroll previews continued to include some employees after their status changed in hr-core-service. Payroll administrators found the inconsistency during preview review.
hr-core-service.resolution_summary: A consumer processing employee status events had stopped after receiving a malformed message. The message was isolated, the consumer was restarted, and queued changes were replayed.

integration-hub.title: Payroll exports omit newly hired employees
integration-hub.description: Payroll administrators saw exports missing employees who had recently been hired. The issue affected downstream payroll processing and was detected when employee counts did not match.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A deployment introduced a filter that excluded employees without a prior payroll record. The filter was corrected and affected exports were regenerated.

integration-hub.title: Timecard deliveries sent to the wrong connector
integration-hub.description: Some timecard batches appeared in the wrong configured destination. Customers reported unexpected records in their integration logs, and affected batches had to be reviewed before payroll submission.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A connector routing configuration mapped two destinations to the same identifier. The mapping was corrected and the affected batches were redelivered.

integration-hub.title: Outbound integrations fail certificate validation
integration-hub.description: Integration-hub could not establish secure connections to several customer endpoints. Delivery failures accumulated until an alert flagged repeated certificate validation errors.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A client certificate used for outbound authentication had expired. The certificate was renewed and queued deliveries were retried.

integration-hub.title: Employee updates remain queued during message broker outage
integration-hub.description: Employee profile changes did not reach connected systems because integration-hub could not publish events. Queue depth alerts detected the backlog before customers reported stale records.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The message broker dependency was unavailable. After the broker recovered, integration-hub drained the backlog and verified delivery counts.

integration-hub.title: Large benefit enrollment files exhaust worker memory
integration-hub.description: Large benefit enrollment exports stopped midway and were retried repeatedly. Worker restart alerts and customer reports revealed that affected files were not reaching their destinations.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The export worker loaded entire files into memory before uploading them. The worker was changed to stream file contents and failed exports were replayed.

integration-hub.title: Connector history pages load slowly for large tenants
integration-hub.description: Administrators experienced long waits when viewing integration delivery history for large tenants. Request latency alerts identified the problem as users attempted to investigate recent deliveries.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A history query scanned delivery records without a suitable index. Adding the index and limiting the query range restored normal response times.

integration-hub.title: Duplicate employee records appear in downstream systems
integration-hub.description: Some connected systems received multiple create events for the same employee. Customers noticed duplicate records and paused synchronization while the affected deliveries were investigated.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: Corrupted deduplication markers caused integration-hub to treat replayed events as new. The markers were repaired, duplicate records were reconciled, and the events were replayed safely.

integration-hub.title: Vendor endpoints cannot be resolved by integration workers
integration-hub.description: Outbound deliveries to several vendor endpoints failed before a connection could be established. An alert on DNS lookup failures detected the issue and customers saw growing delivery backlogs.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A DNS resolver configuration pointed workers to an unreachable resolver. The configuration was corrected and failed deliveries were retried.

integration-hub.title: New payroll connectors fail during authorization
integration-hub.description: Administrators could not finish setting up new payroll connectors. Setup attempts returned an authorization error, which support identified from repeated customer reports.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A permission change removed the service account's ability to store connector credentials. The required permission was restored and customers completed setup.

integration-hub.title: Applicant imports reject records after provider API change
integration-hub.description: Integration-hub rejected applicant records from a recruiting provider, leaving connected hiring workflows out of sync. An increase in import validation failures triggered an alert.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The provider changed a status field from a string to an object. The connector was updated to accept the new format and rejected records were reprocessed.

integration-hub.title: Nightly employee synchronization does not start
integration-hub.description: Scheduled employee updates did not reach connected systems, leaving staff details stale. A missed-run alert detected that the synchronization job had not started.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The job scheduler skipped the task because its schedule expression was invalid. The expression was corrected and the missed synchronization was run.

integration-hub.title: Webhook retries create duplicate shift updates
integration-hub.description: A workforce connector received repeated updates for the same shift. The customer reported duplicate activity after temporary delivery failures caused integration-hub to retry.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: Retry attempts generated new idempotency tokens instead of reusing the original token. The retry logic was fixed and duplicate updates were reconciled.

integration-hub.title: Accented employee names become unreadable in exported files
integration-hub.description: Some employee names appeared as garbled characters in payroll export files. A customer noticed the problem while reviewing a file before submission.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The file writer used a character encoding different from the one declared in the export header. The writer was corrected and affected files were regenerated.

integration-hub.title: Integration status remains pending after successful delivery
integration-hub.description: Administrators saw completed deliveries displayed as pending in integration-hub. Support compared destination receipts with delivery records after customers reported the mismatch.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A status consumer failed to process completion messages because its subscription had been removed. The subscription was restored and outstanding status messages were processed.

integration-hub.title: Payroll exports fail when work locations have long names
integration-hub.description: Exports containing unusually long work location names failed validation before delivery. Repeated failures for a small group of tenants were detected by an export error alert.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A database column for the intermediate location name was shorter than the supported input limit. The column was expanded and failed exports were rerun.

integration-hub.title: Connector authentication fails after token refresh
integration-hub.description: Previously working connectors began returning authorization errors after their access tokens expired. Customers saw failed deliveries, and an alert detected the rise in authentication failures.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The refresh handler saved the new access token but discarded the replacement refresh token. The handler was fixed and affected connectors were reauthorized.

integration-hub.title: Leave balances arrive with incorrect decimal values
integration-hub.description: A leave management destination received balances with misplaced decimal separators. Customers found discrepancies when comparing integration results with employee leave balances.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A locale-dependent formatter changed the representation of decimal values in outbound payloads. The connector was updated to use a consistent numeric format and balances were resynchronized.

integration-hub.title: Bulk integrations delay individual employee updates
integration-hub.description: Individual employee updates took much longer than usual to reach connected systems while large imports were running. Delivery latency alerts showed that small events were waiting behind bulk jobs.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: Bulk and individual events shared a queue without fair scheduling. Separate worker capacity was assigned to individual events and the backlog was cleared.

integration-hub.title: Termination events are rejected by downstream connectors
integration-hub.description: Connected systems continued to show some terminated employees as active. A customer reconciliation report exposed failed termination event deliveries.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: The event mapper sent an empty termination reason where the destination required the field to be omitted. The mapper was corrected and the failed events were replayed.

integration-hub.title: Integration logs expose masked fields as ordinary text
integration-hub.description: Administrators with access to integration logs could see sensitive employee fields that should have been masked. An internal log review detected the exposure and affected log access was restricted.
integration-hub.resolution_summary: A new error logging path bypassed the payload redaction function. Redaction was added to that path and the affected log entries were removed.
